title: Genesis 1:1
text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

title: Genesis 1:2
text: And the earth was without form and empty. And darkness [was] on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved on the face of the waters.

title: Genesis 1:3
text: And God said, Let there be light. And there was light.

title: Genesis 1:4
text: And God saw the light that [it was] good. And God divided between the light and the darkness.

title: Genesis 1:5
text: And God called the light, Day. And He called the darkness, Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

title: Genesis 1:6
text: And God said, Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters [from] the waters.

title: Genesis 1:7
text: And God made the expanse, and divided the waters which [were] under the expanse from the waters which [were] above the expanse; and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:8
text: And God called the expanse, Heavens. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

title: Genesis 1:9
text: And God said, Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear; and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:10
text: And God called the dry land, Earth. And He called the gathering together of the waters, Seas. And God saw that [it was] good.

title: Genesis 1:11
text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth tender sprouts ([the] herb seeding seed [and] the fruit tree producing fruit after its kind, whose seed [is] in itself) upon the earth; and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:12
text: And the earth brought forth tender sprouts, [the] herb yielding seed after its kind, and the tree producing fruit after its kind, whose seed [was] in itself. And God saw that [it was] good.

title: Genesis 1:13
text: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

title: Genesis 1:14
text: And God said, Let there be lights in the expanse of the heavens to divide between the day and the night. And let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years,

title: Genesis 1:15
text: And let them be for lights in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth. And it was so.

title: Genesis 1:16
text: And God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the smaller light to rule the night, and the stars [also.]

title: Genesis 1:17
text: And God set them in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth,

title: Genesis 1:18
text: and to rule over the day and over the night; and to divide between the light and the darkness. And God saw that [it was] good.

title: Genesis 1:19
text: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

title: Genesis 1:20
text: And God said, Let the waters swarm [with] swarmers [having] a living soul; and let birds fly over the earth on the face of the expanse of the heavens.

title: Genesis 1:21
text: And God created great sea-animals, and every living soul that creeps [with] which the waters swarmed after their kind; and every winged fowl after its kind. And God saw that [it was] good.

title: Genesis 1:22
text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters of the seas and let the fowl multiply in the earth.

title: Genesis 1:23
text: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

title: Genesis 1:24
text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle, and creepers, and its beasts of the earth after its kind; and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:25
text: And God made the beasts of the earth after its kind, and cattle after their kind, and all creepers upon the earth after their kind. And God saw that it was good.

title: Genesis 1:26
text: And God said, Let Us make man in Our image, after our likeness. And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the heavens, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over all the creepers creeping on the earth.

title: Genesis 1:27
text: And God created man in His image; in the image of God He created him. He created them male and female.

title: Genesis 1:28
text: And God blessed them. And God said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply and fill the earth, and subdue it. And have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the fowl of the heavens, and all animals that move upon the earth.

title: Genesis 1:29
text: And God said, Behold! I have given you every herb seeding seed which [is] upon the face of all the earth, and every tree in which [is the] fruit of a tree seeding seed; to you it shall be for food.

title: Genesis 1:30
text: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the heavens, and to every creeper on the earth which [has] in it a living soul [shall be] every green plant [is] for food; and it was so.

title: Genesis 1:31
text: And God saw everything that He had made, and behold, [it was] very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

title: Genesis 2:1
text: And the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

title: Genesis 2:2
text: And on the seventh day God ended His work which He had made. And He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had made.

title: Genesis 2:3
text: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He had rested from all His work which God created to make.

title: Genesis 2:4
text: These [are] the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they [were] created in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

title: Genesis 2:5
text: and every shrub of the field was not yet on the earth, and every plant of the field had not yet sprung up. For the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and [there was] no man to till the ground.

title: Genesis 2:6
text: But there went up from the earth a mist and watered all the face of the ground.

title: Genesis 2:7
text: And the LORD God formed man [of the] dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

title: Genesis 2:8
text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden. And there He put the man whom He had formed.

title: Genesis 2:9
text: And out of the ground the LORD God caused to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food. The tree of life also was in the middle of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

title: Genesis 2:10
text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden. And from there it was divided and became four heads.

title: Genesis 2:11
text: The name of the first [is] Pishon; that [is it] which surrounds all the land of Havilah, where [there is] gold.

title: Genesis 2:12
text: And the gold of that land [is] good. There [is] bdellium and the onyx stone.

title: Genesis 2:13
text: And the name of the second river [is] Gihon; it [is] the one that surrounds the whole land of Cush.

title: Genesis 2:14
text: And the name of the third river [is] Tigris; it [is] that which goes toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river [is] Euphrates.

title: Genesis 2:15
text: And the LORD God took the man and put him into the garden of Eden to work it and keep it.

title: Genesis 2:16
text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, You may freely eat of every tree in the garden,

title: Genesis 2:17
text: but you shall not eat of the tree of knowledge of good and evil. For in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die.

title: Genesis 2:18
text: And the LORD God said, [It is] not good that the man should be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.

title: Genesis 2:19
text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field and every fowl of the air, and brought [them] to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called [each] living creature, that [was] its name.

title: Genesis 2:20
text: And Adam gave names to all the cattle, and to the birds of the air, and to every animal of the field. But there was not found a suitable helper for Adam.

title: Genesis 2:21
text: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam, and he slept. And He took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh underneath.

title: Genesis 2:22
text: And the LORD God made the rib (which He had taken from the man) into a woman. And He brought her to the man.

title: Genesis 2:23
text: And Adam said, This [is] now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. [She] shall be called Woman because [she] was taken out of man.

title: Genesis 2:24
text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave to his wife and they shall be one flesh.

title: Genesis 2:25
text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife; and they were not ashamed.

title: Genesis 3:1
text: Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, [Is it] so that God has said, You shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

title: Genesis 3:2
text: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden.

title: Genesis 3:3
text: But of the fruit of the tree which [is] in the middle of the garden, God has said, You shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.

title: Genesis 3:4
text: And the serpent said to the woman, You shall not surely die,

title: Genesis 3:5
text: for God knows that in the day you eat of it, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

title: Genesis 3:6
text: And when the woman saw that the tree [was] good for food. and that it was pleasing to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make wise, she took of its fruit, and ate. She also gave to her husband with her, and he ate.

title: Genesis 3:7
text: And the eyes of both of them were opened. And they knew that they [were] naked. And they sewed fig leaves together and made girdles for themselves.

title: Genesis 3:8
text: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day. And Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God in the middle of the trees of the garden.

title: Genesis 3:9
text: And the LORD God called to Adam and said to him, Where [are] you?

title: Genesis 3:10
text: And he said, I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I [am] naked, and I hid myself.

title: Genesis 3:11
text: And He said, Who told you that you [were] naked? Have you eaten of the tree which I commanded you that you should not eat?

title: Genesis 3:12
text: And the man said, The woman whom You gave [to be] with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate.

title: Genesis 3:13
text: And the LORD God said to the woman, What [is] this you have done? And the woman said, The serpent deceived me, and I ate.

title: Genesis 3:14
text: And the LORD God said to the serpent, Because you have done this you [are] cursed more than all cattle, and more than every animal of the field. You shall go upon your belly, and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

title: Genesis 3:15
text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her Seed; He will bruise your head, and you shall bruise His heel.

title: Genesis 3:16
text: To the woman He said, I will greatly increase your sorrow and your conception. In pain you shall bear sons, and your desire shall be toward your husband, and he shall rule over you.

title: Genesis 3:17
text: And to Adam He said, Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you, saying, You shall not eat [of] it! The ground [is] cursed for your sake. In pain shall you eat of it all the days of your life.

title: Genesis 3:18
text: It shall also bring forth thorns and thistles to you, and you shall eat the herb of the field.

title: Genesis 3:19
text: In the sweat of your face you shall eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For dust you [are], and to dust you shall return.

title: Genesis 3:20
text: And Adam called his wife's name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.

title: Genesis 3:21
text: And for Adam and his wife the LORD God made coats of skins, and clothed them.

title: Genesis 3:22
text: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man has become as one of Us, to know good and evil. And now, lest he put forth his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever,

title: Genesis 3:23
text: therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden to till the ground from which he had been taken.

title: Genesis 3:24
text: And He drove out the man. And He placed cherubs at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

title: Genesis 4:1
text: And Adam knew Eve his wife. And she conceived and bore Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

title: Genesis 4:2
text: And she bore again, his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

title: Genesis 4:3
text: And in the end of days, it happened, Cain brought to the LORD an offering of the fruit of the ground.

title: Genesis 4:4
text: And Abel also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat of it. And the LORD had respect to Abel and to his offering,

title: Genesis 4:5
text: but He did not have respect to Cain and to his offering. And Cain glowed with anger, and his face fell.

title: Genesis 4:6
text: And the LORD said to Cain, Why have you angrily glowed? And why did your face fall?

title: Genesis 4:7
text: If you do well, shall you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin crouches at the door; and its desire [is] for you, and you shall rule over it.

title: Genesis 4:8
text: And Cain talked with his brother Abel. And it happened when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.

title: Genesis 4:9
text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where [is] your brother Abel? And he said, I do not know. [Am] I my brother's keeper?

title: Genesis 4:10
text: And He said, What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries to Me from the ground.

title: Genesis 4:11
text: And now you [are] cursed more than the ground which opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.

title: Genesis 4:12
text: When you till the ground, it will not again give its strength to you. And you shall be a vagabond and a fugitive in the earth.

title: Genesis 4:13
text: And Cain said to the LORD, My punishment [is] greater than I can bear.

title: Genesis 4:14
text: Behold! You have driven me out from the face of the earth today, and I shall be hidden from Your face. And I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth, and it shall be [that] anyone who finds me shall kill me.

title: Genesis 4:15
text: And the LORD said to him, Therefore whoever kills Cain shall be avenged seven times. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain so that anyone who found him should not kill him.

title: Genesis 4:16
text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and lived in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

title: Genesis 4:17
text: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

title: Genesis 4:18
text: And Irad was born to Enoch. And Irad fathered Mehujael. And Mehujael fathered Methusael. And Methusael fathered Lamech.

title: Genesis 4:19
text: And Lamech took two wives to himself. The name of the first one [was] Adah, and the name of the other [was] Zillah.

title: Genesis 4:20
text: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents, and with cattle.

title: Genesis 4:21
text: And his brother's name [was] Jubal; he was the father of all those playing the harp and the organ.

title: Genesis 4:22
text: And Zillah also bore Tubalcain, [the] hammerer of every engraving tool of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

title: Genesis 4:23
text: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice, wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have killed a man because of my wound, and a young man because of my hurt.

title: Genesis 4:24
text: For Cain is avenged seven times, and Lamech seventy-seven times.

title: Genesis 4:25
text: And Adam knew his wife again. And she bore a son, and called his name Seth. For she said, God has appointed me another seed instead of Abel, because Cain killed him.

title: Genesis 4:26
text: And there was also a son born to Seth, and he called his name Enos. Then men began to call upon the name of the LORD.

title: Genesis 5:1
text: This [is] the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in the likeness of God.

title: Genesis 5:2
text: He created them male and female, and blessed them. And He called their name Adam in the day when they were created.

title: Genesis 5:3
text: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years and fathered [a son] in his own likeness, after his own image. And he called his name Seth.

title: Genesis 5:4
text: And the days of Adam after he had fathered Seth were eight hundred years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:5
text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:6
text: And Seth lived one hundred and five years and fathered Enos.

title: Genesis 5:7
text: And after he fathered Enos, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:8
text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:9
text: And Enos lived ninety years and fathered Cainan.

title: Genesis 5:10
text: And after he fathered Cainan, Enos lived eight hundred and fifteen years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:11
text: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:12
text: And Cainan lived seventy years and fathered Mahalaleel.

title: Genesis 5:13
text: And after he fathered Mahalaleel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:14
text: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.

title: Genesis 5:15
text: And Mahalaleel lived sixty-five years and fathered Jared.

title: Genesis 5:16
text: And after he fathered Jared, Mahalaleel lived eight hundred and thirty years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:17
text: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:18
text: And Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years and fathered Enoch.

title: Genesis 5:19
text: And after he fathered Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:20
text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:21
text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and fathered Methuselah.

title: Genesis 5:22
text: And Enoch walked with God three hundred years after he fathered Methuselah. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:23
text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

title: Genesis 5:24
text: And Enoch walked with God, and then he [was] not, for God took him.

title: Genesis 5:25
text: And Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years and fathered Lamech.

title: Genesis 5:26
text: And after he fathered Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:27
text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:28
text: And Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years and fathered a son.

title: Genesis 5:29
text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This one shall comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD has cursed.

title: Genesis 5:30
text: And after he fathered Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 5:31
text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years. And he died.

title: Genesis 5:32
text: And Noah was five hundred years old. And Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

title: Genesis 6:1
text: And it happened, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and when daughters were born to them,

title: Genesis 6:2
text: the sons of God saw the daughters of men, that they [were] good. And they took wives for themselves from all whom they chose.

title: Genesis 6:3
text: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, in his erring; he is flesh. Yet his days shall be a hundred and twenty years.

title: Genesis 6:4
text: There were giants in the earth in those days. And also after that, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men, and they bore to them, they were mighty men who [existed] of old, men of renown.

title: Genesis 6:5
text: And the LORD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great in the earth, and every imagination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil continually.

title: Genesis 6:6
text: And the LORD repented that He had made man on the earth, and He [was] angry to His heart.

title: Genesis 6:7
text: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created, from the face of the earth, both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air. For I repent that I have made them.

title: Genesis 6:8
text: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

title: Genesis 6:9
text: These [are] the generations of Noah. Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations. Noah walked with God.

title: Genesis 6:10
text: And Noah fathered three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

title: Genesis 6:11
text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

title: Genesis 6:12
text: And God looked upon the earth. And, behold, it was corrupted! For all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth.

title: Genesis 6:13
text: And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh has come before Me, for the earth is filled with violence through them. And, behold, I will destroy them [with] the earth.

title: Genesis 6:14
text: Make an ark of cyprus timbers. You shall make rooms in the ark. And you shall pitch it inside and outside with pitch.

title: Genesis 6:15
text: And this [is] the way you shall make it. The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it shall be fifty cubits and its height thirty cubits.

title: Genesis 6:16
text: You shall make a window in the ark, and you shall finish it above to a cubit. And you shall set the door of the ark in the side of it. You shall make it with lower, second and third stories.

title: Genesis 6:17
text: And behold! I, even I, am bringing a flood of waters upon the earth in order to destroy all flesh (in which [is] the breath of life) from under the heavens. Everything which [is] in the earth shall die.

title: Genesis 6:18
text: But I will establish My covenant with you. And you shall come into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.

title: Genesis 6:19
text: And you shall bring into the ark two of every [kind], of every living thing of all flesh, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

title: Genesis 6:20
text: Two of every kind shall come to you to keep [them] alive; of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind.

title: Genesis 6:21
text: And take for yourself all food that is eaten, and you shall gather for yourself. And it shall be for food, for you and for them.

title: Genesis 6:22
text: Noah did so, according to all that God commanded him, so he did.

title: Genesis 7:1
text: And the LORD said to Noah, You and all your house come into the ark, for I have seen you righteous before Me in this generation.

title: Genesis 7:2
text: You shall take with you every clean animal by sevens, the male and female. And take two of the animals that [are] not clean, the male and female.

title: Genesis 7:3
text: Also take of the fowls of the air by sevens, the male and the female, to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

title: Genesis 7:4
text: For in seven more days I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights. And I will destroy from off the face of the earth every living thing that I have made.

title: Genesis 7:5
text: And Noah did according to all that the LORD commanded him.

title: Genesis 7:6
text: And Noah [was] six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

title: Genesis 7:7
text: And Noah went in. And his sons and his wife and his sons' wives went in with him into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

title: Genesis 7:8
text: Of the clean animals, and of the animals that were not clean, and of the fowls, and of everything that creeps on the earth,

title: Genesis 7:9
text: two [by] two they went in to Noah into the ark, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.

title: Genesis 7:10
text: And it happened after seven days that the waters of the flood came into being on the earth.

title: Genesis 7:11
text: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, in the seventeenth day of the month, in this day all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the windows of the heavens were opened up.

title: Genesis 7:12
text: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

title: Genesis 7:13
text: In this same day, Noah and Shem and Ham and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ark.

title: Genesis 7:14
text: They went in, and every animal after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth after its kind, and every fowl after its kind, every bird of every sort.

title: Genesis 7:15
text: And they went in to Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, in which is the breath of life.

title: Genesis 7:16
text: And they that entered, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him. And the LORD shut him in.

title: Genesis 7:17
text: And the flood was upon the earth forty days. And the waters increased and bore up the ark, and it was lifted up above the earth.

title: Genesis 7:18
text: And the waters prevailed and were increased greatly upon the earth. And the ark floated upon the face of the waters.

title: Genesis 7:19
text: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth. And all the high hills that [were] under the whole heaven were covered.

title: Genesis 7:20
text: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.

title: Genesis 7:21
text: And all flesh that moved upon the face of the earth died, of birds, of cattle, of animal, and of every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth; and every man,

title: Genesis 7:22
text: all who breathed the breath of life, of all that [was] in the dry land, died.

title: Genesis 7:23
text: And every living thing which was on the face of the earth was destroyed, from man to cattle, and to the creeping things, and the fowls of the heavens. And they were destroyed from the earth, and only Noah was left, and those that were with him in the ark.

title: Genesis 7:24
text: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.

title: Genesis 8:1
text: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle which [were] with him in the ark. And God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.

title: Genesis 8:2
text: Also the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and rain from heaven was restrained.

title: Genesis 8:3
text: And the waters returned from off the earth continually. And after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters had gone down.

title: Genesis 8:4
text: And in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.

title: Genesis 8:5
text: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth [month]. And the tops of the mountains were seen in the tenth [month] on the first [day] of the month.

title: Genesis 8:6
text: And it happened, at the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made.

title: Genesis 8:7
text: And he sent forth a raven, and it went out, going out and returning until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

title: Genesis 8:8
text: He also sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters had gone down from off the face of the earth.

title: Genesis 8:9
text: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot. And she returned to him into the ark, for the waters [were] on the face of the whole earth. Then he put out his hand and took her, and pulled her in to him into the ark.

title: Genesis 8:10
text: And he waited yet another seven days. And again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.

title: Genesis 8:11
text: And the dove came in to him in the evening. And, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off. So Noah knew that the waters had gone down from off the earth.

title: Genesis 8:12
text: And he waited yet another seven days, and sent forth the dove. And she did not return again to him any more.

title: Genesis 8:13
text: And it happened in the six hundred and first year, at the beginning, on the first of the month, that the waters were dried up from off the earth. And Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked. And, behold, the face of the earth was dried!

title: Genesis 8:14
text: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

title: Genesis 8:15
text: And God spoke to Noah, saying,

title: Genesis 8:16
text: Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives with you.

title: Genesis 8:17
text: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you, of all flesh, of fowl, of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth, so that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful and multiply upon the earth.

title: Genesis 8:18
text: And Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him.

title: Genesis 8:19
text: Every animal, every fowl, and every creeping thing, all which creeps upon the earth after their families, went forth out of the ark.

title: Genesis 8:20
text: And Noah built an altar to the LORD. And he took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

title: Genesis 8:21
text: And the LORD smelled a sweet odor. And the LORD said in His heart, I will never again curse the ground for man's sake, because the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth. And I will not again smite every living thing as I have done.

title: Genesis 8:22
text: While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

title: Genesis 9:1
text: And God blessed Noah and his sons. And He said to them, Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.

title: Genesis 9:2
text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon the animals of the earth, and upon every bird of the air, upon all that moves on the earth, and upon all the fish of the sea. Into your hand they are delivered.

title: Genesis 9:3
text: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. I have given you all things, even as the green herb.

title: Genesis 9:4
text: But you shall not eat of flesh with the life in it, [or] the blood of it.

title: Genesis 9:5
text: and surely the blood of your lives will I require. At the hand of every animal will I require it, and at the hand of man. At the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

title: Genesis 9:6
text: Whoever sheds man's blood, his blood shall be shed by man; for He made man in the image of God.

title: Genesis 9:7
text: And you be fruitful and multiply. Bring forth abundantly in the earth, and increase in it.

title: Genesis 9:8
text: And God spoke to Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

title: Genesis 9:9
text: Behold! I, even I, establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

title: Genesis 9:10
text: and with every living creature that [is] with you, of the birds, of the cattle, and of every animal of the earth with you; from all that go out from the ark, to every animal of the earth.

title: Genesis 9:11
text: And I will establish My covenant with you. Neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood. Neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

title: Genesis 9:12
text: And God said, This [is] the token of the covenant which I make between Me and you and every living creature with you, for everlasting generations:

title: Genesis 9:13
text: I set my rainbow in the cloud. And it shall be a token of a covenant between Me and the earth.

title: Genesis 9:14
text: And it shall be, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow shall be seen in the cloud.

title: Genesis 9:15
text: And I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

title: Genesis 9:16
text: And the rainbow shall be in the cloud. And I will look upon it that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

title: Genesis 9:17
text: And God said to Noah, This [is] the token of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that [is] upon the earth.

title: Genesis 9:18
text: And the sons of Noah that went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham is the father of Canaan.

title: Genesis 9:19
text: These [are] the three sons of Noah, and the whole earth was overspread from them.

title: Genesis 9:20
text: And Noah began [to be] a husbandman. And he planted a vineyard.

title: Genesis 9:21
text: And he drank of the wine and was drunk. And he was uncovered inside his tent.

title: Genesis 9:22
text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

title: Genesis 9:23
text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it upon both their shoulders. And they went backwards and covered the nakedness of their father. And their faces were backwards, and they did not see their father's nakedness.

title: Genesis 9:24
text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and came to know what his younger son had done to him.

title: Genesis 9:25
text: And he said, Cursed [be] Canaan. He shall be a servant of servants to his brothers.

title: Genesis 9:26
text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant.

title: Genesis 9:27
text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem. And Canaan shall be their servant.

title: Genesis 9:28
text: And Noah lived three hundred and fifty years after the flood.

title: Genesis 9:29
text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years. And he died.

title: Genesis 10:1
text: Now these are [the] generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.

title: Genesis 10:2
text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

title: Genesis 10:3
text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

title: Genesis 10:4
text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish and Kittim and Dodanim.

title: Genesis 10:5
text: By these were the coasts of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

title: Genesis 10:6
text: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Phut and Canaan.

title: Genesis 10:7
text: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

title: Genesis 10:8
text: And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

title: Genesis 10:9
text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

title: Genesis 10:10
text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

title: Genesis 10:11
text: Out of that land he went forth [to] Assyria. And he built Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

title: Genesis 10:12
text: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which [is] a great city.

title: Genesis 10:13
text: And Mizraim fathered Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim,

title: Genesis 10:14
text: and Pathrusim and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines) and Caphtorim.

title: Genesis 10:15
text: And Canaan fathered Sidon, his first-born, and Heth,

title: Genesis 10:16
text: and the Jebusite and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

title: Genesis 10:17
text: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

title: Genesis 10:18
text: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. And afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

title: Genesis 10:19
text: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon (as you come to Gerar) to Gaza, as you go in towards Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboim, even to Lasha.

title: Genesis 10:20
text: These [were] the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

title: Genesis 10:21
text: And to Shem were born, even him, the father of all the sons of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.

title: Genesis 10:22
text: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.

title: Genesis 10:23
text: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash,

title: Genesis 10:24
text: And Arpachshad fathered Salah; and Salah fathered Eber.

title: Genesis 10:25
text: And two sons were born to Eber. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. And his brother's name [was] Joktan.

title: Genesis 10:26
text: And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah,

title: Genesis 10:27
text: and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah,

title: Genesis 10:28
text: and Obal and Abimael and Sheba,

title: Genesis 10:29
text: and Ophir and Havilah, and Jobab. All these [were] the sons of Joktan.

title: Genesis 10:30
text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go to Sephar, a mountain of the east.

title: Genesis 10:31
text: These [are] the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, and after their nations.

title: Genesis 10:32
text: These [are] the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations. And from these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

title: Genesis 11:1
text: And the whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

title: Genesis 11:2
text: And it happened, as they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar. And they lived there.

title: Genesis 11:3
text: And they said to one another, Come, let us make brick and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and they had asphalt for mortar.

title: Genesis 11:4
text: And they said, Come, let us build us a city and a tower, and its top in the heavens. And let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered upon the face of the whole earth.

title: Genesis 11:5
text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of Adam had built.

title: Genesis 11:6
text: And the LORD said, Behold! The people [is] one and they all have one language. And this they begin to do. And now nothing which they have imagined to do will be restrained from them.

title: Genesis 11:7
text: Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, so that they cannot understand one another's speech.

title: Genesis 11:8
text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from that place upon the face of all the earth. And they quit building the city.

title: Genesis 11:9
text: Therefore the name of it is called Babel; because the LORD confused the language of all the earth there. And from there the LORD scattered them abroad on the face of all the earth.

title: Genesis 11:10
text: These are the generations of Shem. Shem [was] a hundred years old and fathered Arpachshad two years after the flood.

title: Genesis 11:11
text: And after he fathered Arpachshad, Shem lived five hundred years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:12
text: And Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and fathered Salah.

title: Genesis 11:13
text: And after he fathered Salah, Arpachshad lived four hundred and three years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:14
text: And Salah lived thirty years and fathered Eber.

title: Genesis 11:15
text: And after he fathered Eber, Salah lived four hundred and three years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:16
text: And Eber lived thirty-four years and fathered Peleg.

title: Genesis 11:17
text: And after he fathered Peleg, Eber lived four hundred and thirty years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:18
text: And Peleg lived thirty years and fathered Reu.

title: Genesis 11:19
text: After he fathered Reu, Peleg lived two hundred and nine years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:20
text: And Reu lived thirty-two years and fathered Serug.

title: Genesis 11:21
text: And after he fathered Serug, Reu lived two hundred and seven years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:22
text: And Serug lived thirty years and fathered Nahor.

title: Genesis 11:23
text: And after he fathered Nahor, Serug lived two hundred years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:24
text: And Nahor lived twenty-nine years and fathered Terah.

title: Genesis 11:25
text: And after he fathered Terah, Nahor lived a hundred and nineteen years. And he fathered sons and daughters.

title: Genesis 11:26
text: And Terah lived seventy years and fathered Abram, Nahor and Haran.

title: Genesis 11:27
text: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran fathered Lot.

title: Genesis 11:28
text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans.

title: Genesis 11:29
text: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai. And the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

title: Genesis 11:30
text: But Sarai was barren. She had no child.

title: Genesis 11:31
text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot, the son of Haran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram's wife. And he went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. And they came to Haran and lived there.

title: Genesis 11:32
text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years. And Terah died in Haran.

title: Genesis 12:1
text: And the LORD said to Abram, Go out of your country, and from your kindred, and from your father's house into a land that I will show you.

title: Genesis 12:2
text: And I will make you a great nation. And I will bless you and make your name great. And you shall be a blessing.

title: Genesis 12:3
text: And I will bless those that bless you and curse the one who curses you. And in you shall all families of the earth be blessed.

title: Genesis 12:4
text: And Abram departed, even as the LORD had spoken to him. And Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

title: Genesis 12:5
text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gained in Haran. And they went forth to go into the land of Canaan. And they came into the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 12:6
text: And Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, unto the Oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite [was] then in the land.

title: Genesis 12:7
text: And the LORD appeared to Abram and said, I will give this land to your seed. And he built an altar there to the LORD who appeared to him.

title: Genesis 12:8
text: And he moved from there to a mountain on the east of Bethel. And he pitched his tent [with] Bethel toward the sea and Hai on the east. And he built an altar there to the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

title: Genesis 12:9
text: And Abram journeyed, going on and pulled up [stakes] toward the south.

title: Genesis 12:10
text: And there was a famine in the land. And Abram went down into Egypt to stay there, for the famine [was] grievous in the land.

title: Genesis 12:11
text: And it happened, when he had come near to enter into Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look upon.

title: Genesis 12:12
text: And it will be when the Egyptians see you, they shall say, This [is] his wife. And they will kill me, but they will save you alive.

title: Genesis 12:13
text: I pray you, say that you [are] my sister, so that it may be well with me for your sake. And my soul shall live because of you.

title: Genesis 12:14
text: And it happened when Abram had come into Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman [was] very beautiful.

title: Genesis 12:15
text: The princes of Pharaoh also saw her and commended her before Pharaoh. And the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

title: Genesis 12:16
text: And he treated Abram well for her sake. And he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and male servants, and maidservants, and she-asses, and camels.

title: Genesis 12:17
text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

title: Genesis 12:18
text: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, What [is] this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she [is] your wife?

title: Genesis 12:19
text: Why did you say, She [is] my sister? And so I was about to take her to me as wife. Now therefore behold your wife. Take [her] and go.

title: Genesis 12:20
text: And Pharaoh commanded men concerning him. And they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

title: Genesis 13:1
text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, (and Lot was with him) into the south.

title: Genesis 13:2
text: And Abram [was] very rich in cattle, in silver and in gold.

title: Genesis 13:3
text: And he went on his journeys from the south, even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been from the beginning, between Bethel and Hai,

title: Genesis 13:4
text: to the place of the altar which he had made there at the first. And Abram called on the name of the LORD there.

title: Genesis 13:5
text: And Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

title: Genesis 13:6
text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might live together. For their substance was great, so that they could not live together.

title: Genesis 13:7
text: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle. And the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived then in the land.

title: Genesis 13:8
text: And Abram said to Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray you, between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we [are] men, brothers.

title: Genesis 13:9
text: [Is] not the whole land before you? I pray you, separate yourself from me. If [you go] to the left, then I will go to the right. Or if [you go] to the right, then I will go to the left.

title: Genesis 13:10
text: And Lot lifted up his eyes and saw all the circuit of Jordan, that it [was] all well watered (before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah,) like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt as you come to Zoar.

title: Genesis 13:11
text: And Lot chose all the circuit of Jordan for himself. And Lot journeyed east; and they separated themselves from one another.

title: Genesis 13:12
text: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the circuit and pitched [his] tent toward Sodom.

title: Genesis 13:13
text: But the men of Sodom [were] wicked and sinners before the LORD, exceedingly so.

title: Genesis 13:14
text: And after Lot was separated from him, the LORD said to Abram, Lift up your eyes now and look from the place where you are northward and southward, and eastward and westward.

title: Genesis 13:15
text: For all the land which you see I will give to you, and to your seed forever.

title: Genesis 13:16
text: And I will make your seed as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then shall your seed also be counted.

title: Genesis 13:17
text: Rise up and walk through the land, in the length of it and in the breadth of it, for I will give it to you.

title: Genesis 13:18
text: And Abram moved [his] tent and came and lived in the oaks of Mamre, which [is] in Hebron. And he built an altar to the LORD there.

title: Genesis 14:1
text: And it happened in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,

title: Genesis 14:2
text: they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

title: Genesis 14:3
text: All these were joined together in the valley of Siddim, which is the Salt Sea.

title: Genesis 14:4
text: They served Chedorlaomer twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

title: Genesis 14:5
text: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him came and struck the giants in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

title: Genesis 14:6
text: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, as far as the oak of Paran, which is [by] the wilderness.

title: Genesis 14:7
text: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.

title: Genesis 14:8
text: And the king of Sodom went out, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboim, and the king of Bela (which [is] Zoar). And they joined battle with them in the valley of Siddim;

title: Genesis 14:9
text: with Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal the king of nations, and Amraphel the king of Shinar, and Arioch the king of Ellasar, four kings with five.

title: Genesis 14:10
text: And the valley of Siddim [was] full of asphalt pits. And the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

title: Genesis 14:11
text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

title: Genesis 14:12
text: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who lived in Sodom, and all his goods, and went away.

title: Genesis 14:13
text: And there came one who had escaped. And he told Abram the Hebrew, for he lived in the plains of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. And these had a covenant with Abram.

title: Genesis 14:14
text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained servants, born in his own house (three hundred and eighteen) and pursued them to Dan.

title: Genesis 14:15
text: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants. And he struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which [is] on the left of Damascus.

title: Genesis 14:16
text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

title: Genesis 14:17
text: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and of the kings with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which [is] the king's valley.

title: Genesis 14:18
text: And Melchizedek the king of Salem brought forth bread and wine. And he [was] the priest of the most high God.

title: Genesis 14:19
text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed [be] Abram of the most high God, possessor of Heaven and earth.

title: Genesis 14:20
text: And blessed [be] the most high God, who has delivered your enemies into your hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

title: Genesis 14:21
text: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the people and take the goods for yourself.

title: Genesis 14:22
text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of Heaven and earth,

title: Genesis 14:23
text: that I will take from all that is yours, [not] from a thread even to a shoestring, lest you say, I have made Abram rich.

title: Genesis 14:24
text: Nothing for me, only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

title: Genesis 15:1
text: After these things the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram, I [am] your shield and your exceeding great reward.

title: Genesis 15:2
text: And Abram said, Lord God, what will You give me, since I [am] going childless, and the steward of my house [is] this Eliezer of Damascus?

title: Genesis 15:3
text: And Abram said, Behold, You have given no seed to me. And behold, one born in my house is my heir.

title: Genesis 15:4
text: And behold, the word of the LORD [came] to him saying, This one shall not be your heir. But he that shall come forth out of your own bowels shall be your heir.

title: Genesis 15:5
text: And He brought him outside and said, Look now toward the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them. And He said to him, So shall your seed be.

title: Genesis 15:6
text: And he believed in the LORD. And He counted it to him for righteousness.

title: Genesis 15:7
text: And He said to him, I [am] the LORD that brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.

title: Genesis 15:8
text: And he said, Lord God, by what shall I know that I shall inherit it?

title: Genesis 15:9
text: And He said to him, Take Me a heifer of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

title: Genesis 15:10
text: And he took all these to himself, and divided them in the middle, and laid each piece against one another; but he did not divide the birds.

title: Genesis 15:11
text: And when the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, Abram drove them away.

title: Genesis 15:12
text: And it happened as the sun was setting, and a deep sleep fell upon Abram. And, behold, a horror of great darkness fell upon him!

title: Genesis 15:13
text: And He said to Abram, You must surely know that your seed shall be a stranger in a land not theirs, and shall serve them. And they shall afflict them four hundred years.

title: Genesis 15:14
text: And also I will judge that nation whom they shall serve. And afterward they shall come out with great substance.

title: Genesis 15:15
text: And you shall go to your fathers in peace. You shall be buried in a good old age.

title: Genesis 15:16
text: But in the fourth generation they shall come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

title: Genesis 15:17
text: And it happened, the sun went down, and it was dark [and] behold, a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp passed between those pieces.

title: Genesis 15:18
text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, I have given this land to your seed, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates,

title: Genesis 15:19
text: the Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

title: Genesis 15:20
text: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the giants,

title: Genesis 15:21
text: and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

title: Genesis 16:1
text: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, did not bear. And she had a female slave, an Egyptian, and her name [was] Hagar.

title: Genesis 16:2
text: And Sarai said to Abram, Behold now, the LORD has kept me from bearing. I pray you, go in to my slave woman. It may be that I may be built by her. And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

title: Genesis 16:3
text: And Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar her slave woman, the Egyptian, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife (after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan).

title: Genesis 16:4
text: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

title: Genesis 16:5
text: And Sarai said to Abram, My wrong [be] upon you. I have given my slave woman into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. The LORD judge between me and you.

title: Genesis 16:6
text: But Abram said to Sarai, Behold, your slave woman [is] in your hand. Do to her as it pleases you. And Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

title: Genesis 16:7
text: And the Angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

title: Genesis 16:8
text: And He said, Hagar, Sarai's slave, where did you come from? and where will you go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

title: Genesis 16:9
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to her, Return to your mistress and submit yourself under her hands.

title: Genesis 16:10
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to her, I will multiply your seed exceedingly, so that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

title: Genesis 16:11
text: And the Angel of the LORD said to her, Behold, you are with child, and shall bear a son. And you shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction

title: Genesis 16:12
text: And he will be a wild man. His hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him. And he shall live in the presence of all his brothers.

title: Genesis 16:13
text: And she called the name of the LORD who had spoken to her, You [are] a God of vision! For she said, Even here have I looked after Him that sees me?

title: Genesis 16:14
text: Therefore the well was called The Well of the Living One Seeing Me. Behold, [it is] between Kadesh and Bered.

title: Genesis 16:15
text: And Hagar bore Abram a son. And Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bore, Ishmael.

title: Genesis 16:16
text: And Abram [was] eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

title: Genesis 17:1
text: And when Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, I [am] the Almighty God! Walk before Me and be perfect.

title: Genesis 17:2
text: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.

title: Genesis 17:3
text: And Abram fell on his face. And God talked with him, saying,

title: Genesis 17:4
text: As for Me, behold! My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.

title: Genesis 17:5
text: Neither shall your name any more be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham. For I have made you a father of many nations.

title: Genesis 17:6
text: And I will make you exceedingly fruitful, greatly so, and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come out of you.

title: Genesis 17:7
text: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your seed after you in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your seed after you.

title: Genesis 17:8
text: And I will give the land to you in which you are a stranger, and to your seed after you, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. And I will be their God.

title: Genesis 17:9
text: And God said to Abraham, And you shall keep My covenant, you and your seed after you in their generations.

title: Genesis 17:10
text: This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and your seed after you. Every male child among you shall be circumcised.

title: Genesis 17:11
text: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin. And it shall be a token of the covenant between Me and you.

title: Genesis 17:12
text: And a son of eight days shall be circumcised among you, every male child in your generations; he that is born in the house, or bought with silver of any stranger who [is] not of your seed.

title: Genesis 17:13
text: He that is born in your house, and he that is bought with your silver, must be circumcised. And my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

title: Genesis 17:14
text: And the uncircumcised male child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.

title: Genesis 17:15
text: And God said to Abraham, As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name [shall be] Sarah.

title: Genesis 17:16
text: And I will bless her, and give you a son also of her. Yes, I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother] of nations, kings of people shall be from her.

title: Genesis 17:17
text: And Abraham fell upon his face and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall [a child] be born to him that is a hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear?

title: Genesis 17:18
text: And Abraham said to God, Oh that Ishmael might live before You!

title: Genesis 17:19
text: And God said, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son indeed. And you shall call his name Isaac. And I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

title: Genesis 17:20
text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

title: Genesis 17:21
text: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time in the next year.

title: Genesis 17:22
text: And He left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

title: Genesis 17:23
text: And Abraham took his son Ishmael, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his silver; every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins in the same day, even as God said to him.

title: Genesis 17:24
text: And Abraham [was] ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

title: Genesis 17:25
text: And his son Ishmael [was] thirteen years old [when] he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

title: Genesis 17:26
text: In the same day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.

title: Genesis 17:27
text: And all the men of his house, that were born in the house, and bought with silver of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

title: Genesis 18:1
text: And the LORD appeared to him in the plains of Mamre, and he sat at the tent door in the heat of the day.

title: Genesis 18:2
text: And he lifted up his eyes and looked, and lo, three men stood by him. And when he saw [them], he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed toward the ground.

title: Genesis 18:3
text: And he said, My Lord, if now I have found favor in Your sight, do not pass away, I pray, from Your servant.

title: Genesis 18:4
text: Let a little water, I pray, be brought, and wash Your feet, and rest under the tree.

title: Genesis 18:5
text: And I will bring a bite of bread, and will comfort your hearts. After that You shall pass on. For this is why You have come to Your servant. And they said, Do so, as you have said.

title: Genesis 18:6
text: And Abraham hastened into the tent to Sarah, and said, [Make ready] quickly three measures of fine meal; knead [it], and make cakes.

title: Genesis 18:7
text: And Abraham ran out to the herd and brought a calf, tender and good. And he gave [it] to a young man. And he hurried to dress it.

title: Genesis 18:8
text: And he took butter and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set [it] before them. And he stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

title: Genesis 18:9
text: And they said to him, Where [is] Sarah your wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

title: Genesis 18:10
text: And He said, I will certainly return to you according to the time of life, and lo, Sarah your wife [shall have] a son. And Sarah heard in the tent door which was behind Him.

title: Genesis 18:11
text: Now Abraham and Sarah [were] old, far gone in days, and it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

title: Genesis 18:12
text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After my being old, shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

title: Genesis 18:13
text: And the LORD said to Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I, who am old, truly bear a child?

title: Genesis 18:14
text: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return again, according to the time of life, and Sarah [shall have] a son.

title: Genesis 18:15
text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I did not laugh; for she was afraid. And He said, No, but you did laugh.

title: Genesis 18:16
text: And the men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. And Abraham was going with them to bring them on the way.

title: Genesis 18:17
text: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham the thing which I do,

title: Genesis 18:18
text: And Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the persons of the earth shall be blessed in him?

title: Genesis 18:19
text: For I know him, that he will command his sons and his house after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment, that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which He has spoken of him.

title: Genesis 18:20
text: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

title: Genesis 18:21
text: I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which has come to Me. And if not, I will know.

title: Genesis 18:22
text: And the men turned their faces away from there, and went toward Sodom. But Abraham still stood before the LORD.

title: Genesis 18:23
text: And Abraham drew near and said, Will You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

title: Genesis 18:24
text: Perhaps there are fifty righteous within the city. Will You also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are in it?

title: Genesis 18:25
text: Far be it from You to act in this manner, to kill the righteous with the wicked. And far be it from You, that the righteous should be as the wicked. Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

title: Genesis 18:26
text: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

title: Genesis 18:27
text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak to the LORD, who am but dust and ashes.

title: Genesis 18:28
text: Perhaps there will be five lacking from the fifty righteous. Will You destroy all the city for lack of five? And He said, If I find there forty-five, I will not destroy [it].

title: Genesis 18:29
text: And he spoke to Him yet again, and said, Perhaps there shall be forty found there. And He said, I will not do [it] for forty's sake.

title: Genesis 18:30
text: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak. Perhaps there shall be thirty found there. And He said, I will not do [it] if I find thirty there.

title: Genesis 18:31
text: And he said, Lo now, I have taken upon me to speak to the LORD. Perhaps there shall be twenty found there. And He said, I will not destroy [it] for twenty's sake.

title: Genesis 18:32
text: And he said, Oh do not let the LORD be angry, and I will speak only once more. Perhaps ten shall be found there. And He said, I will not destroy [it] for ten's sake.

title: Genesis 18:33
text: And the LORD went His way as soon as He had left off talking with Abraham. And Abraham returned to his place.

title: Genesis 19:1
text: And there came two angels to Sodom at evening. And Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. And Lot rose up to meet them when he saw [them]. And he bowed himself with his face toward the ground,

title: Genesis 19:2
text: and said, Behold now, my lords, please turn into your servant's house and stay all night, and wash your feet, and [you shall] rise up early and go your way. And they said, No, but we will stay in the street.

title: Genesis 19:3
text: But he urgently pressed on them, and they turned in to him and entered into his house. And he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

title: Genesis 19:4
text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both old and young, all the people from every quarter.

title: Genesis 19:5
text: And they called to Lot, and said to him, Where are the men which came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may know them.

title: Genesis 19:6
text: And Lot went out to the door to them, and shut the door after him.

title: Genesis 19:7
text: And he said, I pray you, brothers, do not act evilly.

title: Genesis 19:8
text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man. I pray you, let me bring them out to you, and you do to them as you see fit. But do nothing to these men, for this is why they came under the shadow of my roof.

title: Genesis 19:9
text: And they said, Stand back! And they said, This one came in to stay, and must he judge always? Now we will deal worse with you than with them. And they pressed hard upon the man, Lot, and came near to breaking the door.

title: Genesis 19:10
text: But the men put out their hands and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

title: Genesis 19:11
text: And they smote the men that [were] at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

title: Genesis 19:12
text: And the men said to Lot, Have you anyone here besides yourself? Bring your sons-in-law, and your sons, and your daughters, and whatever [you have] in the city, bring [them] out of this place.

title: Genesis 19:13
text: For we will destroy this place because great is the cry of them before the face of the LORD. And the LORD has sent us to destroy it.

title: Genesis 19:14
text: And Lot went out and spoke with his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Get up and get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked to his sons-in-law.

title: Genesis 19:15
text: And when the dawn rose up, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, Rise up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

title: Genesis 19:16
text: And he lingered, the angel laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters (the LORD being merciful to him), and they brought him forth and set him outside the city.

title: Genesis 19:17
text: And it happened when they brought him outside, He said, Escape for your life! Do not look behind you, nor stay in all the plain. Escape to the mountain lest you be consumed.

title: Genesis 19:18
text: And Lot said to them, Oh no, Lord,

title: Genesis 19:19
text: behold now, Your servant has found grace in Your sight, and You have magnified Your mercy, which You have shown to me in saving my life. And I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me and I die.

title: Genesis 19:20
text: Behold now, this city [is] near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

title: Genesis 19:21
text: And He said to him, See, I have accepted you concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city for which you have spoken.

title: Genesis 19:22
text: Hurry and escape there! For I cannot do anything till you have come there. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

title: Genesis 19:23
text: The sun had risen upon the earth, and Lot entered into Zoar.

title: Genesis 19:24
text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire, from the LORD out of the heavens.

title: Genesis 19:25
text: And He overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

title: Genesis 19:26
text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

title: Genesis 19:27
text: And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD.

title: Genesis 19:28
text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the lands of the plain, and saw, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

title: Genesis 19:29
text: And when God destroyed the cities of the plain, it happened that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

title: Genesis 19:30
text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him. For he feared to live in Zoar, and he and his two daughters lived in a cave.

title: Genesis 19:31
text: And the first-born said to the younger, Our father [is] old, and [there is] no man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

title: Genesis 19:32
text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, so that we may preserve seed of our father.

title: Genesis 19:33
text: And they made their father drink wine that night. And the first-born went in, and lay with her father. And he did not notice when she lay down nor when she arose.

title: Genesis 19:34
text: And it happened on the next day, the first-born said to the younger, Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine this night also, and you go in and lie down with him so that we may preserve seed of our father.

title: Genesis 19:35
text: And they made their father drink wine that night also, and the younger arose and lay with him. And he did not notice when she lay down nor when she arose.

title: Genesis 19:36
text: So both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.

title: Genesis 19:37
text: And the first-born bore a son, and called his name Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

title: Genesis 19:38
text: And the younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben-ammi; he is the father of the sons of Ammon to this day.

title: Genesis 20:1
text: And Abraham moved from there toward the south country, and lived between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.

title: Genesis 20:2
text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister. And Abimelech the king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

title: Genesis 20:3
text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, you [are] about to die, for the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man's wife.

title: Genesis 20:4
text: But Abimelech had not come near her. And he said, Lord, will You also kill a righteous nation?

title: Genesis 20:5
text: Did he not say to me, She [is] my sister? And she, even she herself said, He [is] my brother. In the sincerity of my heart and innocency of my hands I have done this.

title: Genesis 20:6
text: And God said to him in a dream, Yes, I know that you did this in the sincerity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me. Therefore I did not allow you to touch her.

title: Genesis 20:7
text: Now therefore, restore his wife to the man. For he [is] a prophet, and he shall pray for you, and you shall live. And if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you, and all that are yours.

title: Genesis 20:8
text: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears. And the men were greatly afraid.

title: Genesis 20:9
text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, What have you done to us? In what have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done.

title: Genesis 20:10
text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What did you see that you have done this thing?

title: Genesis 20:11
text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God [is] not in this place, and they will kill me for my wife's sake.

title: Genesis 20:12
text: And yet truly [she is] my sister. She [is] the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother. And she became my wife.

title: Genesis 20:13
text: And it happened when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, This [is] your kindness which you show to me, at every place where we shall come, say of me, He [is] my brother.

title: Genesis 20:14
text: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave [them] to Abraham. And he restored him Sarah his wife.

title: Genesis 20:15
text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land [is] before you. Live where it pleases you.

title: Genesis 20:16
text: And to Sarah he said, Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, he [is] to you a covering of the eyes, to all that [are] with you, and with all this, you are justified.

title: Genesis 20:17
text: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his slave women, and they gave birth.

title: Genesis 20:18
text: For the Lord had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

title: Genesis 21:1
text: And the LORD visited Sarah as He had said. And the LORD did to Sarah as He had spoken.

title: Genesis 21:2
text: For Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

title: Genesis 21:3
text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born to him (whom Sarah bore to him) Isaac.

title: Genesis 21:4
text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

title: Genesis 21:5
text: And Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

title: Genesis 21:6
text: And Sarah said, God has made me laugh, so that all who hear will laugh with me.

title: Genesis 21:7
text: And she said, Who could have said to Abraham, will Sarah suckle children? For I have borne a son to him in his old age.

title: Genesis 21:8
text: And the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast the day that Isaac was weaned.

title: Genesis 21:9
text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian (whom she had borne to Abraham) mocking.

title: Genesis 21:10
text: And she said to Abraham, Cast out this slave woman and her son. For the son of this slave woman shall not be heir with my son, with Isaac.

title: Genesis 21:11
text: And the thing was very evil in Abraham's sight, because of his son.

title: Genesis 21:12
text: And God said to Abraham, Let it not be grievous in your sight because of the boy and because of your slave woman. In all that Sarah has said to you, listen to her voice. For in Isaac your Seed shall be called.

title: Genesis 21:13
text: And also, I will make a nation of the son of the slave woman, because he [is] your seed.

title: Genesis 21:14
text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave [it] to Hagar, putting [it] on her shoulder. And he gave her the boy, and sent her away. And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

title: Genesis 21:15
text: And the water was gone in the bottle, and she cast the boy under one of the shrubs.

title: Genesis 21:16
text: And she went and sat down across from him, a good way off, about a bowshot. For she said, Let me not see the death of the boy. And she sat across from him, and lifted up her voice, and cried.

title: Genesis 21:17
text: And God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar out of the heavens, and said to her, What ails you, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

title: Genesis 21:18
text: Rise up, lift up the boy and hold him up with your hand, for I will make him a great nation.

title: Genesis 21:19
