text: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in Mount Seir.

title: Genesis 36:10
text: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau; Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

title: Genesis 36:11
text: And the sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

title: Genesis 36:12
text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau's son. And she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These [were] the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:13
text: And these [were] the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these [were] the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:14
text: And these were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife. And she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

title: Genesis 36:15
text: These [were] the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,

title: Genesis 36:16
text: Chief Korah, Chiefs Gatam, Chief Amalek. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these the sons of Adah.

title: Genesis 36:17
text: And these [were] the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chief Nahath, and Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, Chief Mizzah. These [were] the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:18
text: And these [were] the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, Chief Korah. These were the chiefs of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

title: Genesis 36:19
text: These [were] the sons of Esau, and these their chiefs. He [is] Edom.

title: Genesis 36:20
text: These [were] the sons of Seir the Horite living in the land: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

title: Genesis 36:21
text: and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan. These [were] the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.

title: Genesis 36:22
text: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Heman; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

title: Genesis 36:23
text: And these were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

title: Genesis 36:24
text: And these [were] the sons of Zibeon: both Aiah and Anah (he is Anah that found the hot springs in the desert as he fed the asses of Zibeon, his father).

title: Genesis 36:25
text: And the sons of Anah [were] these: Dishon. And Oholibamah [was] the daughter of Anah.

title: Genesis 36:26
text: And these [were] sons of Dishon: Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

title: Genesis 36:27
text: The sons of Ezer [were] these: Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

title: Genesis 36:28
text: The sons of Dishan [were] these: Uz and Aran.

title: Genesis 36:29
text: These [were] the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,

title: Genesis 36:30
text: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, Chief Dishan. These [were] the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

title: Genesis 36:31
text: And these [were] the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before the reigning of a king over the sons of Israel.

title: Genesis 36:32
text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom. And the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

title: Genesis 36:33
text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah, from Bozrah, reigned in his place.

title: Genesis 36:34
text: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

title: Genesis 36:35
text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab reigned in his place. And the name of his city [was] Avith.

title: Genesis 36:36
text: And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.

title: Genesis 36:37
text: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth [by] the river reigned in his place.

title: Genesis 36:38
text: And Shaul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

title: Genesis 36:39
text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Pau. And his wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

title: Genesis 36:40
text: And these [were] the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,

title: Genesis 36:41
text: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

title: Genesis 36:42
text: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

title: Genesis 36:43
text: Chief Magdiel, Chief Iram. These [were] the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwellings in the land of their possession; he [is] Esau the father of the Edomites.

title: Genesis 37:1
text: And Jacob lived in the land of the travels of his father, in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 37:2
text: These [are] the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a son of seventeen years, came tending the flock with his brothers. And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought to his father an evil report of them.

title: Genesis 37:3
text: And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was the son of his old age. And he made him a tunic [reaching to] the soles [of his] feet.

title: Genesis 37:4
text: And when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.

title: Genesis 37:5
text: And Joseph dreamed a dream and told [it] to his brothers. And they hated him still more.

title: Genesis 37:6
text: And he said to them, I pray you, Hear this dream which I have dreamed.

title: Genesis 37:7
text: For behold! We [were] binding sheaves in the middle of the field, and lo, my sheaf arose and also stood upright. And behold, your sheaves stood around and bowed down to my sheaf.

title: Genesis 37:8
text: And his brothers said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have the rule over us? And they hated him still more for his dreams and for his words.

title: Genesis 37:9
text: And he dreamed still another dream, and told it to his brothers. And he said, Behold, I have dreamed another dream. And behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars bowed down to me.

title: Genesis 37:10
text: And he told [it] to his father and to his brothers. And his father rebuked him and said to him, What [is] this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I, and your mother, and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves to the earth before you?

title: Genesis 37:11
text: And his brothers were jealous of him. But his father observed the saying.

title: Genesis 37:12
text: And his brothers went to feed his father's flock in Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:13
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not your brothers feed the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here I [am].

title: Genesis 37:14
text: And he said to him, please go see whether it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks. And bring me word again. And he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

title: Genesis 37:15
text: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, What are you looking for?

title: Genesis 37:16
text: And he said, I [am] seeking for my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding?

title: Genesis 37:17
text: And the man said, They are gone from here, for I heard [them] say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

title: Genesis 37:18
text: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.

title: Genesis 37:19
text: And they said to one another, Behold, this dreamer comes.

title: Genesis 37:20
text: Therefore come now, and let us kill him, and throw him into some pit, and we will say some evil beast has devoured him. And we shall see what will become of his dreams.

title: Genesis 37:21
text: And Reuben heard, and [he] delivered him out of their hands and said, Let us not kill him.

title: Genesis 37:22
text: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him (in order to rescue him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again).

title: Genesis 37:23
text: And it happened when Joseph had come to his brothers, they stripped Joseph out of his tunic, the tunic reaching to the soles [of his] feet that was on him.

title: Genesis 37:24
text: And they took him and threw him into a pit. And the pit [was] empty, with no water in it.

title: Genesis 37:25
text: And they sat down to eat bread. And they lifted up their eyes, and looked. And behold, a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:26
text: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit [is it] if we should kill our brother and hide his blood?

title: Genesis 37:27
text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him. For he [is] our brother, and our flesh. And his brothers listened.

title: Genesis 37:28
text: And men, Midianites traders, came by. And they drew up Joseph and took him out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty [pieces] of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.

title: Genesis 37:29
text: And Reuben returned to the pit. And behold! Joseph [was] not in the pit! And he tore his clothes.

title: Genesis 37:30
text: And he returned to his brothers and said, The child, he is not. And I, where shall I go?

title: Genesis 37:31
text: And they took Joseph's tunic, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

title: Genesis 37:32
text: And they sent the tunic [reaching to] the soles of the feet, and they brought it to their father. And they said, We have found this. Do you know whether it [is] your son's coat or not?

title: Genesis 37:33
text: And he knew it, and said, [It is] my son's tunic. An evil beast has eaten him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.

title: Genesis 37:34
text: And Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

title: Genesis 37:35
text: And all his sons, and all his daughters, rose up to comfort him. But he refused to be comforted. And he said, For I will go down into the grave to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.

title: Genesis 37:36
text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, a eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the executioners.

title: Genesis 38:1
text: And it happened at that time Judah went down from his brothers and turned in to a certain Adullamite, named Hirah.

title: Genesis 38:2
text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shuah. And he took her and went in to her.

title: Genesis 38:3
text: And she conceived and bore a son. And he called his name Er.

title: Genesis 38:4
text: And she conceived again, and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.

title: Genesis 38:5
text: And she yet again conceived and bore a son. And she called his name Shelah. And she was at Chezib when she bore him.

title: Genesis 38:6
text: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, whose name [was] Tamar.

title: Genesis 38:7
text: And Er, Judah's first-born, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. And the LORD killed him.

title: Genesis 38:8
text: And Judah said to Onan, Go in to your brother's wife, and marry [her], and raise up seed to your brother.

title: Genesis 38:9
text: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it happened when he went in to his brother's wife, that he spilled on the ground, not giving seed to his brother.

title: Genesis 38:10
text: And what he did was evil in the eyes of the LORD. Therefore He killed him also.

title: Genesis 38:11
text: Then said Judah to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, Remain a widow at your father's house until Shelah my son is grown. For he said, Lest perhaps he die also, as his brothers [did]. And Tamar went and lived in her father's house.

title: Genesis 38:12
text: And the days were many, and Judah's wife, the daughter of Shuah, died. And Judah was comforted, and went up to shearers of his sheep, he and his friend Hiram of Adullam, to Timnah.

title: Genesis 38:13
text: And it was told to Tamar, saying, Behold, your father-in-law goes up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

title: Genesis 38:14
text: And she put off her widow's clothes, and covered herself with a veil, and wrapped herself. And [she] sat in an open place, which [is] by the way to Timnah. For she saw that Shelah was grown and she was not given to him as wife.

title: Genesis 38:15
text: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a harlot, because she had covered her face.

title: Genesis 38:16
text: And he turned aside to her by the wayside, and said, Come now, let me come in to you. For he did not know that she [was] his daughter-in-law. And she said, What will you give me, so that you may come in to me?

title: Genesis 38:17
text: And he said, I will send a kid of the goats from the flock. And she said, Will you give me a pledge until you send [it]?

title: Genesis 38:18
text: And he said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, Your signet, and your bracelet, and your staff that [is] in your hand. And he gave to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

title: Genesis 38:19
text: And she arose, and went away, and laid away her veil from her, and put on the clothes of her widowhood.

title: Genesis 38:20
text: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive [his] pledge from the woman's hand. But he did not find her.

title: Genesis 38:21
text: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where [is] the harlot who was by the wayside? And they said, There [was] no harlot here.

title: Genesis 38:22
text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her. And also the men of the place said, There [was] no harlot here.

title: Genesis 38:23
text: And Judah said, Let her take [it] to her, lest we be ashamed. Behold, I sent this kid, and you have not found her.

title: Genesis 38:24
text: And it happened, about three months afterward, that it was told Judah, saying, Your daughter-in-law Tamar has played the harlot, and also, behold, she [is] with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burned.

title: Genesis 38:25
text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, I am with child by the man whose things these [are]. And she said, Please observe. Whose things are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff?

title: Genesis 38:26
text: And Judah acknowledged [them], and said, She has been more righteous than I have, because I did not give her to my son Shelah. And he never knew her again.

title: Genesis 38:27
text: And it happened, in the time of her travail, behold, twins [were] in her womb.

title: Genesis 38:28
text: And when she travailed, it happened that [one] put out a hand. And the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This one came out first.

title: Genesis 38:29
text: And it happened as he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out. And she said, How have you broken a break for yourself? And his name was called Pharez.

title: Genesis 38:30
text: And afterwards his brother came out, on whose hand was the scarlet thread. And his name was called Zarah.

title: Genesis 39:1
text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt. And Potiphar, a eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the executioners, an Egyptian man, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

title: Genesis 39:2
text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. And he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

title: Genesis 39:3
text: And his master saw that the LORD [was] with him, and that the LORD made all he did to prosper in his hand.

title: Genesis 39:4
text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him. And he made him overseer over his house, and he put into his hand all he had.

title: Genesis 39:5
text: And it happened from the time he had made him overseer in his house, and over all he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake. And the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.

title: Genesis 39:6
text: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand. And he did not know anything that he had, except the bread which he ate. And Joseph was beautiful in form and beautiful in appearance.

title: Genesis 39:7
text: And after these things it happened that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph. And she said, Lie with me.

title: Genesis 39:8
text: But he refused and said to his master's wife, Behold, my master does not know what [is] in the house with me, and he has given all that he has into my hand.

title: Genesis 39:9
text: [There is] none greater in this house than I. Neither has he kept back anything from me except you, because you [are] his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

title: Genesis 39:10
text: And it happened as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he did not listen to her to lie with her, [or] to be with her.

title: Genesis 39:11
text: And it happened about this time that he came into the house to do his work. And none of the men of the house [were] inside.

title: Genesis 39:12
text: And she caught him by his robe, saying, Lie with me. And he left his robe in her hand and fled, and got out.

title: Genesis 39:13
text: And it happened when she saw that he had left his robe in her hand, and had fled,

title: Genesis 39:14
text: she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, See, he has brought in a Hebrew to us to mock us. He came in to me, to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

title: Genesis 39:15
text: And it happened when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his robe with me, and fled, and got out.

title: Genesis 39:16
text: And she laid up his robe beside her until his lord came home.

title: Genesis 39:17
text: And she spoke to him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant which you have brought to us came in to me to mock me.

title: Genesis 39:18
text: And it happened as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his robe with me and ran out.

title: Genesis 39:19
text: And it happened when his master heard the words of his wife which she spoke to him, saying, Your servant did this to me, his wrath was kindled.

title: Genesis 39:20
text: And Joseph's master took him and put him in the prison, a place where the king's prisoners [were] bound. And he was there in the prison.

title: Genesis 39:21
text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed him mercy, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

title: Genesis 39:22
text: And the keeper of the prison gave all the prisoners in the prison into Joseph's hand. And whatever they did there, he was the doer of it.

title: Genesis 39:23
text: The keeper of the prison did not look to anything under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and whatever he did, the LORD made [it] to prosper.

title: Genesis 40:1
text: And after these things it happened that the cupbearer of the king of Egypt, and his baker, had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

title: Genesis 40:2
text: And Pharaoh was angry against two of his eunuchs, against the chief of the cupbearers and against the chief of the bakers.

title: Genesis 40:3
text: And he put them under guard in the house of the chief of the executioners, into the prison, the place where Joseph [was] bound.

title: Genesis 40:4
text: And the chief of the executioners charged Joseph with them, and he served them. And they continued for a time under guard.

title: Genesis 40:5
text: And they dreamed a dream, both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who [were] bound in the prison.

title: Genesis 40:6
text: And Joseph came in to them in the morning, and looked upon them, and behold, they [were] sad.

title: Genesis 40:7
text: And he asked Pharaoh's eunuchs who [were] with him under guard in his lord's house, saying, Why are your faces sad today?

title: Genesis 40:8
text: And they said to him, We have dreamed a dream, and [there is] no interpreter of it. And Joseph said to them, Do not interpretations [belong] to God? Now tell it to me.

title: Genesis 40:9
text: And the chief cupbearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine [was] before me.

title: Genesis 40:10
text: And in the vine [were] three branches. And it was as if it budded, and its blossom shot up. And the clusters of it brought forth ripe grapes.

title: Genesis 40:11
text: And Pharaoh's cup [was] in my hand. And I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

title: Genesis 40:12
text: And Joseph said to him, This [is] the interpretation of it. The three branches are three days.

title: Genesis 40:13
text: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head and restore you to your place. And you shall deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.

title: Genesis 40:14
text: But remember me when it is well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

title: Genesis 40:15
text: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

title: Genesis 40:16
text: When the chief baker saw the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, I also [saw] in my dream, and three baskets of white bread [were] on my head.

title: Genesis 40:17
text: And in the top basket [were] all kinds of baked foods for Pharaoh. And the birds ate them out of the basket upon my head.

title: Genesis 40:18
text: And Joseph answered and said, This [is] the interpretation of it. The three baskets are three days.

title: Genesis 40:19
text: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head from off you, and shall hang you on a tree. And the birds shall eat your flesh from off you.

title: Genesis 40:20
text: And it happened on the third day, Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast to all his servants. And he lifted up the head of the chief cupbearer, and of the chief baker, among his servants.

title: Genesis 40:21
text: And he restored the chief cupbearer back into his cupbearer office again. And he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

title: Genesis 40:22
text: But he hanged the chief baker, even as Joseph had interpreted to them.

title: Genesis 40:23
text: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.

title: Genesis 41:1
text: And it happened at the end of two years of days, Pharaoh dreamed. And behold, he stood by the River.

title: Genesis 41:2
text: And behold! There came up out of the river seven cows beautiful of form, and fat of flesh. And they fed in the reeds!

title: Genesis 41:3
text: And behold! Seven other cows came up after them out of the River, evil in appearance, and lean of flesh! And they stood by the other cows on the river bank.

title: Genesis 41:4
text: And the evil-appearing and lean-fleshed cows ate up the seven beautifully formed and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.

title: Genesis 41:5
text: And he slept and dreamed the second time. And behold! Seven ears of grain came up on one stock, fat and good!

title: Genesis 41:6
text: And behold! Seven thin ears, and blasted with the east [wind], sprang up after them!

title: Genesis 41:7
text: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven fat and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and behold, [it was] a dream.

title: Genesis 41:8
text: And it happened in the morning that his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men of it. And Pharaoh told them his dream, but [there was] none who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:9
text: Then the chief cupbearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, I remember my sin this day.

title: Genesis 41:10
text: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me under guard in the chief of the executioner's house, me and the chief baker.

title: Genesis 41:11
text: And we dreamed a dream one night, he and I. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

title: Genesis 41:12
text: And there was there with us a young man, a Hebrew, a slave to the chief of the executioners. And we told him, and he interpreted our dreams to us. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

title: Genesis 41:13
text: And it happened, as he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.

title: Genesis 41:14
text: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph. And they hurried him out of the dungeon. And he shaved and changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:15
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and none can interpret it. And I have heard it about you, saying, you can understand a dream to interpret it.

title: Genesis 41:16
text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, Not I. God shall give answer the welfare of Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:17
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, In my dream, behold! I stood upon the bank of the river.

title: Genesis 41:18
text: And behold, there came up out of the river seven cows, beautiful in appearance and fat of flesh. And they fed in the reeds.

title: Genesis 41:19
text: And behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and evil of appearance, and lean of flesh, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness.

title: Genesis 41:20
text: And the lean and the evil-appearing cows ate up the first seven fat cows.

title: Genesis 41:21
text: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be seen that they had eaten them; but they [were] still evil of appearance, as at the beginning. And I awoke.

title: Genesis 41:22
text: And I saw in my dream, and behold, seven ears came up in one stock, full and good.

title: Genesis 41:23
text: And behold, seven ears, withered, thin, blasted [by] the east [wind], sprang up after them.

title: Genesis 41:24
text: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears. And I spoke to the magicians, but there was none that could open [it] to me.

title: Genesis 41:25
text: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one. God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.

title: Genesis 41:26
text: The seven good cows [are] seven years. And the seven good ears [are] seven years. The dream [is] one.

title: Genesis 41:27
text: And the seven thin and evil-appearing cows that came up after them [are] seven years. And the seven empty ears blasted [with] the east [wind] shall be seven years of famine.

title: Genesis 41:28
text: This [is] the thing which God has spoken to Pharaoh; what God is about to do, He shows to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 41:29
text: Behold, [there are] coming seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:30
text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine. And all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt, and the famine shall consume the land.

title: Genesis 41:31
text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land because of the famine following; for it [shall be] very grievous.

title: Genesis 41:32
text: And since the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice, it is because the thing [is] established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

title: Genesis 41:33
text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a man who is discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:34
text: Let Pharaoh act, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

title: Genesis 41:35
text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

title: Genesis 41:36
text: That food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt, so that the land does not perish through the famine.

title: Genesis 41:37
text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

title: Genesis 41:38
text: And Pharaoh said to his servants, Can we find any man like this, [in] whom the Spirit of God [is]?

title: Genesis 41:39
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since God has shown you all this, no one [is] as discreet and wise as you.

title: Genesis 41:40
text: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall kiss [the hand] at your word. Only in the throne will I be greater than you.

title: Genesis 41:41
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:42
text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand. And he dressed him with fine linen robes, and put a gold chain around his neck.

title: Genesis 41:43
text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had, and they cried before him, Bow the knee! And he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:44
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I [am] Pharaoh, and without [a word] from you, no man shall lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:45
text: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah. And he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah, priest of On, for his wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:46
text: And Joseph [was] thirty years [old] when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from before Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:47
text: And in the seven years of plenty, the earth brought forth by handfuls.

title: Genesis 41:48
text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which [were] in the land of Egypt, and he put food in the cities. He put the food of the field which [was] around every city; he put it in among it.

title: Genesis 41:49
text: And Joseph gathered grain like the sand of the sea, very much, until he quit numbering it; for it was without number.

title: Genesis 41:50
text: And two sons were born to Joseph before the years of famine came, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bore to him.

title: Genesis 41:51
text: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh, saying, For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father's house.

title: Genesis 41:52
text: And the name of the second he called Ephraim, saying, For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

title: Genesis 41:53
text: And the seven years of plenty that was in the land of Egypt ended.

title: Genesis 41:54
text: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said. And the famine was in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

title: Genesis 41:55
text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. And Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.

title: Genesis 41:56
text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth. And Joseph opened all [the storehouses], and sold to the Egyptians. And the famine was severe on the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 41:57
text: And all the earth came into Egypt to buy, to Joseph, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

title: Genesis 42:1
text: And when Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, Why do you look upon one another?

title: Genesis 42:2
text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us from there, so that we may live and not die.

title: Genesis 42:3
text: And Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.

title: Genesis 42:4
text: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob did not send with his brothers. For he said, Lest perhaps mischief happen to him.

title: Genesis 42:5
text: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those that came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:6
text: And Joseph [was] the potentate over the land. He selling to all the people of the earth. And Joseph's brothers came and bowed down themselves before him, their faces to the earth.

title: Genesis 42:7
text: And Joseph saw his brothers, and he knew them, but remained a stranger to them, and spoke roughly to them. And he said to them, Where do you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

title: Genesis 42:8
text: And Joseph knew his brothers, but they did not know him.

title: Genesis 42:9
text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said to them, You [are] spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.

title: Genesis 42:10
text: And they said to him, No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

title: Genesis 42:11
text: We [are] all one man's sons. We are honest; your servants are not spies.

title: Genesis 42:12
text: And he said to them, No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land.

title: Genesis 42:13
text: And they said, Your servants [are] twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. And behold, the youngest [is] this day with our father, and one [is] not.

title: Genesis 42:14
text: And Joseph said to them, That [is] what I spoke to you, saying, You [are] spies!

title: Genesis 42:15
text: By this you shall be proved; [as] Pharaoh lives you shall not go forth from here unless your youngest brother comes here.

title: Genesis 42:16
text: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother, and you shall be kept in prison so that your words may be proved, whether [any] truth [is] in you. Or else, [as] Pharaoh lives, surely you [are] spies.

title: Genesis 42:17
text: And he put them together into custody three days.

title: Genesis 42:18
text: And Joseph said to them the third day, Do [this] and live. I fear God.

title: Genesis 42:19
text: If you [are] honest, let one of your brothers be bound in the house of your prison. You go carry grain [for] the famine of your houses.

title: Genesis 42:20
text: But bring your youngest brother to me, and let your words confirmed, be proved true, and you shall not die. And they did so.

title: Genesis 42:21
text: And they said one to another, We [are] truly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul when he begged us, and we would not hear. Therefore this distress has come upon us.

title: Genesis 42:22
text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Did I not speak to you saying, Do not sin against the youth? And you would not hear. Therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

title: Genesis 42:23
text: And they did not know that Joseph understood, for the interpreter was between them.

title: Genesis 42:24
text: And he turned from them, and wept. And he returned to them again and talked with them, and took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.

title: Genesis 42:25
text: Then Joseph commanded their sacks to be filled [with] grain, and returned their silver, each into his sack, and to give them provision for the way. And so he did to them.

title: Genesis 42:26
text: And they loaded their asses with grain, and departed from there.

title: Genesis 42:27
text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass fodder in the inn, he saw his silver. For, behold, it [was] in the mouth of the sack.

title: Genesis 42:28
text: And he said to his brothers, My silver has been put back. And, also look in my sack. And their hearts failed, and they each were afraid, saying to one another, What [is] this God has done to us?

title: Genesis 42:29
text: And they came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that happened to them, saying,

title: Genesis 42:30
text: The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

title: Genesis 42:31
text: And we said to him, We [are] honest, we [are] not spies.

title: Genesis 42:32
text: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father. One [is] not, and the youngest [is] this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 42:33
text: And the man, the lord of the country, said to us, By this I shall know that you [are] honest. Leave one, your brother, with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and go.

title: Genesis 42:34
text: And bring your youngest brother to me. Then I shall know that you [are] not spies, but that you [are] honest. And I will deliver you your brother, and you shall trade in the land.

title: Genesis 42:35
text: And it happened they emptied their sacks, behold, every man's bundle of silver [was] in his sack. And when they and their father saw the bundles of silver, they were afraid.

title: Genesis 42:36
text: And Jacob their father said to them, You have bereaved me. Joseph [is] not, and Simeon [is] not, and you will take Benjamin. All these things are against me.

title: Genesis 42:37
text: And Reuben spoke to his father, saying, Kill my two sons if I do not bring him to you. Deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to you again.

title: Genesis 42:38
text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you. For his brother is dead, and he is left alone. And [if] mischief should happen to him by the way you go, then you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

title: Genesis 43:1
text: And the famine [was] severe in the land.

title: Genesis 43:2
text: And it happened, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, Go again, buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 43:3
text: And Judah spoke to him, saying, The man solemnly protested to us, saying, You shall not see my face unless your brother [is] with you.

title: Genesis 43:4
text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.

title: Genesis 43:5
text: But if you will not send [him], we will not go down. For the man said to us, You shall not see my face unless your brother [is] with you.

title: Genesis 43:6
text: And Israel said, Why have you dealt ill with me, to tell the man whether you [had] yet a brother?

title: Genesis 43:7
text: And they said, The man asked us strictly of our state and of our kindred, saying, [Is] your father still alive? Have you yet [another] brother? And we told him according to the tenor of these words. Could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

title: Genesis 43:8
text: And Judah said to Israel his father, Send the boy with me, and we will arise and go, so that we may live and not die, both we and you, also our little ones.

title: Genesis 43:9
text: I will be surety for him. You shall require him of my hand. If I do not bring him to you and set him before you, I shall be a sinner against you all the days.

title: Genesis 43:10
text: For unless we had lingered, surely now we would have returned the second time.

title: Genesis 43:11
text: And their father Israel said to them, If [it be] so now, do this. Take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels, and bring a present down to the man, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds.

title: Genesis 43:12
text: And take double silver in your hand, and the silver that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand. Perhaps it [was] an oversight.

title: Genesis 43:13
text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again to the man.

title: Genesis 43:14
text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, so that he may send away your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved, I am bereaved.

title: Genesis 43:15
text: And the men took that present, and they took double silver in their hand, and Benjamin. And they rose up and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

title: Genesis 43:16
text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring the men into the house, and kill an animal and make ready. For the men shall dine with me at noon.

title: Genesis 43:17
text: And the man did as Joseph said. And the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

title: Genesis 43:18
text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house. And they said, Because of the silver that was returned in our sacks at the first time we are brought in, to throw himself on us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

title: Genesis 43:19
text: And they came near to the man over Joseph's house, and they talked with him at the door of the house,

title: Genesis 43:20
text: and said, Oh sir, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

title: Genesis 43:21
text: And it happened, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, [every] man's silver [was] in the mouth of his sack, our silver in full weight. And we have brought it again in our hands.

title: Genesis 43:22
text: And we have brought down other silver in our hands to buy food. We cannot tell who put our silver in our sacks.

title: Genesis 43:23
text: And he said, Peace to you, do not fear. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I had your silver. And he brought Simeon out to them.

title: Genesis 43:24
text: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave [them] water, and they washed their feet. And he gave fodder to their asses.

title: Genesis 43:25
text: And they made ready the presents for the coming of Joseph at noon. For they heard that they should eat bread there.

title: Genesis 43:26
text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

title: Genesis 43:27
text: And he asked them as to [their] welfare, and said, [Is] your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? [Is] he still alive?

title: Genesis 43:28
text: And they answered, Your servant, our father, [is] in good health. He [is] still alive. And they bowed down their heads and fell before him.

title: Genesis 43:29
text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, [Is] this your younger brother of whom you spoke to me? And he said, God bless you, my son.

title: Genesis 43:30
text: And Joseph made haste, for his bowels yearned toward his brother. And he sought a [place] to weep. And he entered into his room and wept there.

title: Genesis 43:31
text: And he washed his face, and went out, and controlled himself, and said, Set the bread on.

title: Genesis 43:32
text: And they set it on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians may not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 43:33
text: And they sat before him, the first-born according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth. And the men marveled at one another.

title: Genesis 43:34
text: And one took portions to them from before him. But Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

title: Genesis 44:1
text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks [with] food, as much as they can carry, and put each one's silver in his sack's mouth.

title: Genesis 44:2
text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain silver. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

title: Genesis 44:3
text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

title: Genesis 44:4
text: They had gone out of the city, not having gone far. And Joseph said to his steward, Rise up, follow after the men and overtake them, and say to them, Why have you rewarded evil for good?

title: Genesis 44:5
text: Is this not [that] in which my lord drinks, and by which indeed he divines? You have done evil in so doing.

title: Genesis 44:6
text: And he overtook them, and he spoke to them these words.

title: Genesis 44:7
text: And they said to him, Why does your lord say these words? Far be it that your servants should do according to this thing.

title: Genesis 44:8
text: Behold, the silver which we found in our sack's mouth, we brought it in to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal out of your lord's house silver or gold?

title: Genesis 44:9
text: [With] whomever of your servants it may be found, both let him die, and we all will be my lord's bondmen.

title: Genesis 44:10
text: And he said, Now also [let] it [be] according to your word. He with whom it is found shall be my servant, and you shall be blameless.

title: Genesis 44:11
text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and each one opened his sack.

title: Genesis 44:12
text: And he searched first at the oldest and with the youngest last. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

title: Genesis 44:13
text: Then they tore their clothes, and each one loaded his ass and returned to the city.

title: Genesis 44:14
text: And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, for he [was] still there. And they fell before him to the earth.

title: Genesis 44:15
text: And Joseph said to them, What deed is this that you have done? Do you not know that one like me can certainly divine?

title: Genesis 44:16
text: And Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we [are] my lord's servants, both we and he also with whom the cup is found.

title: Genesis 44:17
text: And he said, Be it far from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant. And as for you, you go in peace to your father.

title: Genesis 44:18
text: And Judah came near him and said, O my lord, pray let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears, and do not let your anger burn against your servant, for you [are] even as Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 44:19
text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Do you have a father or a brother?

title: Genesis 44:20
text: And we said to my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one. And his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.

title: Genesis 44:21
text: And you said to your servants, Bring him down to me, and let me see him.

title: Genesis 44:22
text: And we said to my lord, The boy cannot leave his father, for [if] he should leave [his father], he would die.

title: Genesis 44:23
text: And you said to your servants, Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.

title: Genesis 44:24
text: And it happened when we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

title: Genesis 44:25
text: And our father said, Go again. Buy us a little food.

title: Genesis 44:26
text: And we said, We cannot go down. If our youngest brother is with us, we will go down, for we may not see the man's face unless our youngest brother [is] with us.

title: Genesis 44:27
text: And your servant my father said to us, You know that my wife bore me two [sons].

title: Genesis 44:28
text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces. And I never saw him since.

title: Genesis 44:29
text: And [if] you take this one also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

title: Genesis 44:30
text: And now when I come to your servant my father, and the boy [is] not with us, since his life is bound up in his life,

title: Genesis 44:31
text: it shall be, when he sees that the boy [is] not [with us], he will die. And your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

title: Genesis 44:32
text: For your servant became surety for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not bring him to you, then I shall bear the blame to my father forever.

title: Genesis 44:33
text: And now please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a slave to my lord. And let the boy go up with his brothers.

title: Genesis 44:34
text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the boy [is] not with me lest perhaps I see the evil that will find my father?

title: Genesis 45:1
text: Then Joseph could not control himself before all those who stood by him. And he cried, Cause every man to go out from me! And no man stood before him [while] Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

title: Genesis 45:2
text: And he wept aloud. And the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

title: Genesis 45:3
text: And Joseph said to his brothers, I [am] Joseph. Is my father still live? And his brothers could not answer him, for they were troubled at his presence.

title: Genesis 45:4
text: And Joseph said to his brothers, Please come near me. And they came near. And he said, I [am] Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:5
text: And now do not be grieved, nor angry with yourselves that you sold me here. For God sent me before you to preserve life.

title: Genesis 45:6
text: For these two years the famine [has been] in the land, and [there are] still five years in which there [will be] no plowing nor harvest.

title: Genesis 45:7
text: And God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

title: Genesis 45:8
text: And now you did not send me here, but God. And He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler over all the land of Egypt.

title: Genesis 45:9
text: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, So says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me, do not wait.

title: Genesis 45:10
text: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your sons and your sons' sons, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have.

title: Genesis 45:11
text: And I will nourish you there, for [there are] still five years of famine, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.

title: Genesis 45:12
text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that [it is] my mouth that speaks to you.

title: Genesis 45:13
text: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. And you shall hurry and bring down my father here.

title: Genesis 45:14
text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck and wept. And Benjamin wept upon his neck.

title: Genesis 45:15
text: And he kissed all his brothers, and wept upon them. And afterwards his brothers talked with him.

title: Genesis 45:16
text: And the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brothers have come. And it was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and of his servants.

title: Genesis 45:17
text: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Do this; load your beasts and go into the land of Canaan,

title: Genesis 45:18
text: and take your father and your households and come to me. And I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

title: Genesis 45:19
text: Now you are commanded; do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

title: Genesis 45:20
text: And do not regard your stuff, for the good of all the land of Egypt [is] yours.

title: Genesis 45:21
text: And the sons of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them wagons according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

title: Genesis 45:22
text: To all of them he gave each man changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred [pieces] of silver, and five changes of clothing.

title: Genesis 45:23
text: And to his father he sent this: ten asses loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses loaded with grain and bread and food for his father by the way.

title: Genesis 45:24
text: And he sent his brothers away, and they departed. And he said to them, Do not quarrel along the way.

title: Genesis 45:25
text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came [to] the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

title: Genesis 45:26
text: And they told him, saying, Joseph [is] still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he did not believe them.

title: Genesis 45:27
text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. And when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

title: Genesis 45:28
text: And Israel said, [It is] enough. Joseph my son [is] still alive. I will go and see him before I die.

title: Genesis 46:1
text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

title: Genesis 46:2
text: And God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob! And he said, Here I [am].

title: Genesis 46:3
text: And He said, I [am] God, the God of your fathers. Do not fear to go down into Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation.

title: Genesis 46:4
text: I will go down with you into Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again. And Joseph shall put his hand on your eyes.

title: Genesis 46:5
text: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba. And the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

title: Genesis 46:6
text: And they took their cattle, and their goods which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

title: Genesis 46:7
text: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed, he brought with him into Egypt.

title: Genesis 46:8
text: And these [were] the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.

title: Genesis 46:9
text: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

title: Genesis 46:10
text: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan.

title: Genesis 46:11
text: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

title: Genesis 46:12
text: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah. But Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez: Hezron and Hamul.

title: Genesis 46:13
text: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

title: Genesis 46:14
text: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

title: Genesis 46:15
text: These [were] the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

title: Genesis 46:16
text: And the sons of Gad [were] Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

title: Genesis 46:17
text: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and their sister Serah. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

title: Genesis 46:18
text: These [are] the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these whom she bore to Jacob, sixteen souls.

title: Genesis 46:19
text: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.

title: Genesis 46:20
text: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah the priest of On bore him.

title: Genesis 46:21
text: And the sons of Benjamin: Belah and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

title: Genesis 46:22
text: These [are] the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob. All the souls [were] fourteen.

title: Genesis 46:23
text: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

title: Genesis 46:24
text: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

title: Genesis 46:25
text: These [were] the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob. All the souls [were] seven.

title: Genesis 46:26
text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, who came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls [were] sixty-six.

title: Genesis 46:27
text: And the sons of Joseph, who [were] born to him in Egypt, [were] two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, [were] seventy.

title: Genesis 46:28
text: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to direct his face to Goshen.

title: Genesis 46:29
text: And Joseph made his chariot ready, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself to him. And he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

title: Genesis 46:30
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you [are] still alive.

title: Genesis 46:31
text: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's house, I will go up and show Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

title: Genesis 46:32
text: And the men [are] shepherds, for they have been men of cattle. And they have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.

title: Genesis 46:33
text: And it shall be when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What [is] your occupation?

title: Genesis 46:34
text: Then you shall say, Your servants have been men of cattle from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers, so that you may live in the land of Goshen, for every shepherd [is] an abomination to the Egyptians.

title: Genesis 47:1
text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brothers, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, have come out of the land of Canaan.

title: Genesis 47:2
text: And behold, they [are] in the land of Goshen. And he took some of his brothers, five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:3
text: And Pharaoh said to his brothers, What [is] your occupation? And they said to Pharaoh, Your servants [are] shepherds, both we and our fathers.

title: Genesis 47:4
text: And they said to Pharaoh, For we have come to live in the land. For your servants have no pasture left for their flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. And now please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 47:5
text: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, Your father and your brothers have come to you.

title: Genesis 47:6
text: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and brothers to live in the best of the land; in the land of Goshen let them live. And if you know men of ability among them, then make them overseers of livestock, over what is mine.

title: Genesis 47:7
text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:8
text: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, How many are the days of the years of your life?

title: Genesis 47:9
text: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage [are] a hundred and thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and I have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

title: Genesis 47:10
text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

title: Genesis 47:11
text: And Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh commanded.

title: Genesis 47:12
text: And Joseph nourished his father and his brothers, and all his father's household, [with] bread, for the mouth of the little ones.

title: Genesis 47:13
text: And no bread [was] in all the land, for the famine [was] very severe, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted because of the famine.

title: Genesis 47:14
text: And Joseph gathered up all the silver found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought. And Joseph brought the silver into Pharaoh's house.

title: Genesis 47:15
text: And when silver failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For the silver has failed.

title: Genesis 47:16
text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle, and I will give you for your cattle, if silver has failed.

title: Genesis 47:17
text: And they brought their cattle to Joseph. And Joseph gave them bread for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses. And he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

title: Genesis 47:18
text: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year and said, We will not hide [it] from my lord, that our silver has failed, also our herds of cattle, [going] to my lord. Nothing is left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies and our lands.

title: Genesis 47:19
text: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants for Pharaoh. And give [us] seed, that we may live and not die, that the land be not desolate.

title: Genesis 47:20
text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them and the land became Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:21
text: And as for the people, he caused them to go into the cities, from [one] end of the borders of Egypt even to the [other] end of it.

title: Genesis 47:22
text: Only he did not buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. Therefore they did not sell their land.

title: Genesis 47:23
text: And Joseph said to the people, Behold, I have bought you this day, and your land, for Pharaoh. Lo, [here is] seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

title: Genesis 47:24
text: And it shall be, as you gather you shall give the fifth [part] to Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for those of your household, and for food for your little ones.

title: Genesis 47:25
text: And they said, You have saved our lives. Let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

title: Genesis 47:26
text: And Joseph made it a law of the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth [part], excepting only the land of the priests, which did not become Pharaoh's.

title: Genesis 47:27
text: And Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen. And they had possession in it, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

title: Genesis 47:28
text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. And the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were a hundred forty-seven years.

title: Genesis 47:29
text: And the days of Israel to die drew near. And he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If now I have found grace in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh and deal kindly and truly with me. Please do not bury me in Egypt.

title: Genesis 47:30
text: But I will lie with my fathers. You shall carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burying-place. And he said, I will do according to your words.

title: Genesis 47:31
text: And he said, Swear to me. And he swore to him. And Israel bowed on the head of the bed.

title: Genesis 48:1
text: And it happened after these things, that [one] told Joseph, Behold, your father [is] sick. And he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

title: Genesis 48:2
text: And [one] spoke to Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes to you. And Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

title: Genesis 48:3
text: And Jacob said to Joseph, God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me.

title: Genesis 48:4
text: And He said to me, Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you. And I will make of you a multitude of people, and will give this land to your seed after you [for] an everlasting possession.

title: Genesis 48:5
text: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who are born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, [are] mine; like Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

title: Genesis 48:6
text: And your issue, which you father after them, shall be yours, and shall be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

title: Genesis 48:7
text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan in the way, when [there was] still but a little way to come to Ephrath. And I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; it [is] Bethlehem.

title: Genesis 48:8
text: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who [are] these?

title: Genesis 48:9
text: And Joseph said to his father, They [are] my sons, whom God has given me in this [place]. And he said, please bring them to me, and I will bless them.

title: Genesis 48:10
text: And the eyes of Israel were dim for age; he could not see. And he brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.

title: Genesis 48:11
text: And Israel said to Joseph, I had not thought I would see your face, and, lo, God has showed me also your seed.

title: Genesis 48:12
text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed his face to the earth.

title: Genesis 48:13
text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left, and Manasseh in his left toward Israel's right hand. And he brought [them] near to him.

title: Genesis 48:14
text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid [it] on Ephraim's head, who [was] the younger, and his left on Manasseh's head, crossing his hands. For Manasseh [was] the first-born.

title: Genesis 48:15
text: And he blessed Joseph and said, May God, [before] whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who fed me all my life to this day,

title: Genesis 48:16
text: the Angel who redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads. And let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and let them grow like the fishes into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

title: Genesis 48:17
text: And Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, and it was evil in his eyes. And he held up his father's hand to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

title: Genesis 48:18
text: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father. For this [is] the first-born. Put your right hand on his head.

title: Genesis 48:19
text: And his father refused and said, I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great, but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he is, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

title: Genesis 48:20
text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Israel bless, saying, God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh. And he put Ephraim before Manasseh.

title: Genesis 48:21
text: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die. But God shall be with you, and bring you again into the land of your fathers.

title: Genesis 48:22
text: And I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

title: Genesis 49:1
text: And Jacob called to his sons and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in the days to come.

title: Genesis 49:2
text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel your father.

title: Genesis 49:3
text: Reuben, you [are] my first-born, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.

title: Genesis 49:4
text: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father's bed; then you defiled it. He went up to my couch.

title: Genesis 49:5
text: Simeon and Levi [are] brothers; tools of violence [are] their weapons.

title: Genesis 49:6
text: Oh my soul, do not come into their secret. Let not my honor be united with their assembly. For in their anger they killed a man, and in their self-will they hamstrung a bull.

title: Genesis 49:7
text: Let their anger be cursed, for [it was] fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

title: Genesis 49:8
text: Judah, may your brothers praise you. May your hand [be] in the neck of your enemies. May your father's sons bow before you.

title: Genesis 49:9
text: Judah [is] a lion's whelp. My son, you have gone up from the prey. He stooped, he crouched like a lion; and like a lioness, who shall rouse him?

title: Genesis 49:10
text: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor a Lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come. And the obedience of the peoples to him.

title: Genesis 49:11
text: Binding his foal to the vine, and his ass's colt to the choice vine, he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes.

title: Genesis 49:12
text: His eyes [shall be] sparkling with wine, and his teeth white from milk.

title: Genesis 49:13
text: Zebulun shall live at the sea shore. And he [shall be] a haven for ships, and his border beside Sidon.

title: Genesis 49:14
text: Issachar [is] a strong ass crouching down between the sheepfolds.

title: Genesis 49:15
text: And he saw that rest [was] good and that the land was pleasant. And he bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a tribute-slave.

title: Genesis 49:16
text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

title: Genesis 49:17
text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse's heels, so that its rider shall fall backward.

title: Genesis 49:18
text: I have waited for Your salvation, O LORD.

title: Genesis 49:19
text: Gad, raiders shall attack him, and he shall attack [their] heel.

title: Genesis 49:20
text: Out of Asher his bread [shall be] fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

title: Genesis 49:21
text: Naphtali [is] a deer let loose. He gives goodly words.

title: Genesis 49:22
text: Joseph [is] a fruitful son, a fruitful son by a well, whose branches run over the wall.

title: Genesis 49:23
text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot [at him], and an archer lurks for him.

title: Genesis 49:24
text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob (from the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel);

title: Genesis 49:25
text: by the God of your father, who shall help you. And may the Almighty bless you with blessings of Heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

title: Genesis 49:26
text: The blessings of your father are above the blessings of my ancestors, to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him, the ruler, the leader of his brothers.

title: Genesis 49:27
text: Benjamin is a wolf that tears in pieces. In the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

title: Genesis 49:28
text: All these [were] the twelve tribes of Israel. And this [is] what their father spoke to them, and blessed them; everyone according to his blessing he blessed them.

title: Genesis 49:29
text: And he charged them and said to them, I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

title: Genesis 49:30
text: in the cave that [is] in the field of Machpelah, which [is] before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, the field which Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite for a burying-place.

title: Genesis 49:31
text: They buried Abraham and his wife Sarah there, and they buried Isaac and his wife Rebekah. And I buried Leah there;

title: Genesis 49:32
text: the purchase of the field and the cave in it, from the sons of Heth.

title: Genesis 49:33
text: And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed. And he expired, and was gathered to his people.

title: Genesis 50:1
text: And Joseph fell on his father's face, and wept on him, and kissed him.

title: Genesis 50:2
text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel.

title: Genesis 50:3
text: And forty days were fulfilled for him, for so are fulfilled the days of those who are embalmed. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

title: Genesis 50:4
text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, I pray you speak in the ears of Pharaoh saying,

title: Genesis 50:5
text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die. You shall bury me in my grave which I have dug for me in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, I pray you, let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.

title: Genesis 50:6
text: And Pharaoh said, Go up and bury your father, according as he made you swear.

title: Genesis 50:7
text: And Joseph went up to bury his father. And all the servants of Pharaoh went up with him, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

title: Genesis 50:8
text: and all the house of Joseph, and his brothers, and his father's house. They left only their little ones and their flocks and their herds in the land of Goshen.

title: Genesis 50:9
text: And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. And it was a very great company.

title: Genesis 50:10
text: And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation. And he made a mourning for his father seven days.

title: Genesis 50:11
text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the grain floor of thorns, and they said, This [is] a grievous mourning to the Egyptians. Therefore they called its name, Meadow of Egypt, which [is] beyond Jordan.

title: Genesis 50:12
text: And his sons did to him according as he commanded them.

title: Genesis 50:13
text: For his sons carried him to the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a burying place from Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

title: Genesis 50:14
text: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

title: Genesis 50:15
text: And when Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will perhaps hate us, and will certainly repay us all the evil which we did to him.

title: Genesis 50:16
text: And they sent a message to Joseph, saying, Your father commanded before he died, saying,

title: Genesis 50:17
text: So shall you say to Joseph, please lift up the rebellion of your brothers, and their sin. For they did evil to you. And please now lift up the rebellion of the servants of the God of your father. And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

title: Genesis 50:18
text: And his brothers also went and fell down before his face. And they said, Behold, we [are] your servants.

title: Genesis 50:19
text: And Joseph said to them, Do not fear. For [am] I in the place of God?

title: Genesis 50:20
text: But as for you, you thought evil against me, [but] God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as [it is] this day, to save a great many people alive.

title: Genesis 50:21
text: And now do not fear. I will nourish you and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spoke to their hearts.

title: Genesis 50:22
text: And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father's house. And Joseph lived a hundred and ten years.

title: Genesis 50:23
text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's sons of the third [generation]. Also the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh were born on Joseph's knees.

title: Genesis 50:24
text: And Joseph said to his brothers, I die. And God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land into the land which He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

title: Genesis 50:25
text: And Joseph took an oath of the sons of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.

title: Genesis 50:26
text: So Joseph died, [being] a hundred and ten years old. And they embalmed him, and put him in a coffin in Egypt.

title: Exodus 1:1
text: And these [were] the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt. Every man and his household came with Jacob:

title: Exodus 1:2
text: Reuben; Simeon; Levi; and Judah;

title: Exodus 1:3
text: Issachar; Zebulun; and Benjamin,

title: Exodus 1:4
text: Dan; and Naphtali; Gad; and Asher.

title: Exodus 1:5
text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls, for Joseph was [already] in Egypt.

title: Exodus 1:6
text: And Joseph died, and all his brothers, and all that generation.

title: Exodus 1:7
text: And the sons of Israel were fruitful, and increased very much, and multiplied, and became exceedingly mighty. And the land was filled [with] them.

title: Exodus 1:8
text: And there arose a new king over Egypt, who did not know Joseph.

title: Exodus 1:9
text: And he said to his people, Behold, the people of the sons of Israel [are] many and mightier than we.

title: Exodus 1:10
text: Come, let us deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it will be when there comes a war, they join also to our enemies, and fight against us, and get out of the land.

title: Exodus 1:11
text: And they set taskmasters over them to afflict them with their burdens. And they built treasure cities for Pharaoh, Pithon and Raamses.

title: Exodus 1:12
text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the sons of Israel.

title: Exodus 1:13
text: And the Egyptians made the sons of Israel serve with harshness.

title: Exodus 1:14
text: And they made their lives bitter with hard work in mortar and in bricks, and in all [kinds of] work in the field; all their work in which they made them do [was] with harshness.

title: Exodus 1:15
text: And the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one [was] Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah.

title: Exodus 1:16
text: And he said, When you midwife the Hebrew women, and look on the birth stools, if it [is] a son, then you shall kill him. But if it [is] a daughter, then she shall live.

title: Exodus 1:17
text: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved alive the male children.

title: Exodus 1:18
text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, Why have you done this thing, and have saved the male children alive?

title: Exodus 1:19
text: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women [are] not like the Egyptian women. For they [are] lively, and are delivered before the midwives come in to them.

title: Exodus 1:20
text: And God dealt well with the midwives. And the people multiplied and became very mighty.

title: Exodus 1:21
text: And it happened, because the midwives feared God, [that] He made them houses.

title: Exodus 1:22
text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.

title: Exodus 2:1
text: And a man went from the house of Levi and took a daughter of Levi [as his wife].

title: Exodus 2:2
text: And the woman conceived and bore a son. And when she saw him, that he was beautiful, she hid him three months.

title: Exodus 2:3
text: But when she could no longer hide him, she took an ark of papyrus for him, and daubed it with bitumen and with pitch, and put the child in it. And she laid [it] in the reeds by the river's edge.

title: Exodus 2:4
text: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.

title: Exodus 2:5
