text: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to bathe at the river. And her maidens walked along by the riverside. And when she saw the ark among the reeds, she sent her slave-girl to bring it.

title: Exodus 2:6
text: And she opened [it], and she saw the child. And behold, a boy wept. And she had pity on him, and said, This [is] one of the Hebrews' sons.

title: Exodus 2:7
text: And his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call a woman, a nurse of the Hebrew women for you, that she may nurse the child for you?

title: Exodus 2:8
text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the girl went and called [the] child's mother.

title: Exodus 2:9
text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take this child away and nurse it for me, and I will give your wages. And the woman took the child and nursed it.

title: Exodus 2:10
text: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses. And she said, Because I took him out of the water.

title: Exodus 2:11
text: And it happened in those days, when Moses was grown, he went out to his brothers and looked upon their burdens. And he saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

title: Exodus 2:12
text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he did not see anyone, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

title: Exodus 2:13
text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together. And he said to the guilty one, Why do you strike your neighbor?

title: Exodus 2:14
text: And he said, Who made you as a man, a ruler and a judge over us? Do you intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

title: Exodus 2:15
text: And when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian. And [he] sat down by a well.

title: Exodus 2:16
text: And the priest of Midian [had] seven daughters. And they came and drew, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

title: Exodus 2:17
text: And the shepherds came and drove them away. But Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

title: Exodus 2:18
text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, Why have you hurried to come today?

title: Exodus 2:19
text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew for us and watered the flock.

title: Exodus 2:20
text: And he said to his daughters, And where [is] he? Why then have you left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.

title: Exodus 2:21
text: And Moses was content to live with the man. And he gave Moses his daughter Zipporah.

title: Exodus 2:22
text: And she bore a son, and he called his name Gershom. For he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

title: Exodus 2:23
text: And it happened after many days the king of Egypt died. And the sons of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

title: Exodus 2:24
text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered His covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

title: Exodus 2:25
text: And God looked upon the sons of Israel, and God knew [them].

title: Exodus 3:1
text: And Moses kept the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. And he led the flock to the back side of the desert. And he came to the mountain of God, to Horeb.

title: Exodus 3:2
text: And the Angel of the LORD appeared to him in a flame of fire, out of the midst of a thorn bush. And he looked. And behold! The thorn bush burned with fire! And the thorn bush [was] not burned up.

title: Exodus 3:3
text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside and see this great sight, why the thorn bush is not burned up.

title: Exodus 3:4
text: And the LORD saw that he had turned aside to see, God called to him out of the midst of the thorn bush, and said, Moses! Moses! And he said, Here I [am].

title: Exodus 3:5
text: And He said, Do not come near here. Put off your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you stand [is] holy ground.

title: Exodus 3:6
text: And He said, I [am] the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look upon God.

title: Exodus 3:7
text: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of My people who [are] in Egypt; I have heard their cry because of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows.

title: Exodus 3:8
text: And I am coming down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, to bring them up out of that land, to a good land, a large land, to a land flowing [with] milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites and the Jebusites.

title: Exodus 3:9
text: And now behold, the cry of the sons of Israel has come to Me. And I have also seen the oppression [with] which the Egyptians oppress them.

title: Exodus 3:10
text: And now go, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring forth My people, the sons of Israel, out of Egypt.

title: Exodus 3:11
text: And Moses said to God, Who [am] I that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the sons of Israel out of Egypt?

title: Exodus 3:12
text: And He said, I will be with you. And this [shall be] the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought forth the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God upon this mountain.

title: Exodus 3:13
text: And Moses said to God, Behold, [when] I come to the sons of Israel, and shall say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you, and they shall say to me, What [is] His name? What shall I say to them?

title: Exodus 3:14
text: And God said to Moses, I AM THAT I AM. And He said, So you shall say to the sons of Israel, I AM has sent me to you.

title: Exodus 3:15
text: And God said to Moses again, You shall say this to the sons of Israel, Jehovah the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you. This [is] My name forever, and this [is] My title from generation to generation.

title: Exodus 3:16
text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel and say to them, Jehovah the God of your fathers has appeared to me, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I have surely visited you and [have seen what] is done to you in Egypt.

title: Exodus 3:17
text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey.

title: Exodus 3:18
text: And they shall listen to your voice. And you shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt. And you shall say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews has met with us. And now let us go, we beseech you, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

title: Exodus 3:19
text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

title: Exodus 3:20
text: And I will stretch out My hand and smite Egypt with all My wonders which I will do in the midst of it. And after that he will let you go.

title: Exodus 3:21
text: And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. And it shall be that when you go, you shall not go empty.

title: Exodus 3:22
text: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her that stays in her house, jewels of silver and jewels of gold and clothing. And you shall put [them] upon your sons and upon your daughters. And you shall plunder the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 4:1
text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me nor listen to my voice. For they will say, The LORD has not appeared to you.

title: Exodus 4:2
text: And the LORD said to him, What [is] this in your hand? And he said, A staff.

title: Exodus 4:3
text: And He said, Throw it on the ground. And he threw it on the ground. And it became a serpent. And Moses ran from it.

title: Exodus 4:4
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Put forth your hand and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand and caught it, and it became a staff in his hand, --

title: Exodus 4:5
text: so that they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.

title: Exodus 4:6
text: And the LORD said to him again, Now put your hand in your bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom. And when he took it out, behold, his hand [was] as leprous as snow.

title: Exodus 4:7
text: And He said, Put your hand into your bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again. And he brought it out of his bosom, and behold, it was turned again like his [other] flesh.

title: Exodus 4:8
text: And it will be, if they will not believe you, neither listen to the voice of the first sign, then they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

title: Exodus 4:9
text: And also it will be, if they will not believe these two signs, neither listen to your voice, then you shall take from the water of the river and pour [it] upon the dry land. And the water which you take out of the river shall become blood on the dry land.

title: Exodus 4:10
text: And Moses said to the LORD, O my Lord, I [am] not a man of words now, nor since You have spoken to Your servant, but I [am] slow of speech and of a slow tongue.

title: Exodus 4:11
text: And the LORD said to him, Who has made man's mouth? Or who makes the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? Have not I, the LORD?

title: Exodus 4:12
text: And now go, and I will be with your mouth and teach you what you shall say.

title: Exodus 4:13
text: And he said, O my Lord, I pray You, send by the hand [of him whom] You will send.

title: Exodus 4:14
text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses. And He said, Do I not know Aaron the Levite, your brother that he can speak well? And also, behold, he comes forth to meet you. And when he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

title: Exodus 4:15
text: And you shall speak to him, and you shall put words in his mouth. And I will be with your mouth and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

title: Exodus 4:16
text: And it will be, he shall speak for you to the people, and he shall be for a mouth to you. And you shall be to him a god.

title: Exodus 4:17
text: And you shall take this rod in your hand, [with] which you shall do signs.

title: Exodus 4:18
text: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, Please let me go and return to my brothers who [are] in Egypt and see if they [are] still alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

title: Exodus 4:19
text: And the LORD said to Moses in Midian, Go! Return to Egypt, for all the men who sought your life are dead.

title: Exodus 4:20
text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt. And Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

title: Exodus 4:21
text: And the LORD said to Moses, When you go to return into Egypt, see that you do all those wonders which I have put in your hand before Pharaoh; but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

title: Exodus 4:22
text: And you shall say to Pharaoh, Thus says the Lord: Israel [is] My son, My first-born.

title: Exodus 4:23
text: And I say to you, Let My son go, that he may serve Me. And if you refuse to let him go, behold, I [am] going to kill your son, your first-born.

title: Exodus 4:24
text: And it happened by the way, in the inn, that the LORD met him and sought to kill him.

title: Exodus 4:25
text: And Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and threw [it] at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband you [are] to me.

title: Exodus 4:26
text: So He let him go. Then she said, [You are] a bloody husband, because of the circumcision.

title: Exodus 4:27
text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

title: Exodus 4:28
text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which He had commanded him.

title: Exodus 4:29
text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the sons of Israel.

title: Exodus 4:30
text: And Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

title: Exodus 4:31
text: And the people believed. And when they heard that the LORD had visited the sons of Israel, and that He had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed and worshiped.

title: Exodus 5:1
text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in and told Pharaoh, Thus says Jehovah, God of Israel: Let My people go, that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.

title: Exodus 5:2
text: And Pharaoh said, Who [is] Jehovah, that I should obey His voice to let Israel go? I do not know Jehovah, neither will I let Israel go.

title: Exodus 5:3
text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Let us go, we pray you, three days' journey into the desert and sacrifice to the LORD our God, lest He fall upon us with plague or with the sword.

title: Exodus 5:4
text: And the king of Egypt said to them, Moses and Aaron, why do you keep the people from their work? Get to your burdens!

title: Exodus 5:5
text: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now [are] many, and you make them rest from their burdens.

title: Exodus 5:6
text: And Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers the same day, saying,

title: Exodus 5:7
text: You shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

title: Exodus 5:8
text: And you shall lay upon them the number of bricks which they have made before now. You shall not take away from it. For they are idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go sacrifice to our God.

title: Exodus 5:9
text: Let more work be laid upon the men, and let them labor in it. And do not let them regard vain words.

title: Exodus 5:10
text: And the taskmasters of the people and their officers went out. And they spoke to the people, saying, So says Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

title: Exodus 5:11
text: Go and get straw where you can find it, yet not any of your work shall be taken away.

title: Exodus 5:12
text: So the people were scattered through all the land of Egypt, to gather stubble for straw.

title: Exodus 5:13
text: And the taskmasters hurried [them], saying, Finish your works, the thing of a day, just as when there was straw.

title: Exodus 5:14
text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel, whom Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten. [And they] demanded, Why have you not completed your task in making brick, both yesterday and today, as you did before?

title: Exodus 5:15
text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, Why do you deal so with your servants?

title: Exodus 5:16
text: There is no straw given to your servants, and they say to us, Make bricks! And behold, your servants [are] beaten, but the fault is in your own people.

title: Exodus 5:17
text: But he said, You [are] idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, Let us go, let us sacrifice to the LORD.

title: Exodus 5:18
text: Therefore go now [and] work, for there shall be no straw given to you; yet you shall deliver the number of bricks.

title: Exodus 5:19
text: And the overseers of the sons of Israel saw themselves in affliction, after it was said, You shall not take away from your bricks of your daily task.

title: Exodus 5:20
text: And they met Moses and Aaron standing in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh.

title: Exodus 5:21
text: And they said to them, The LORD look upon you and judge, because you have made our smell to stink in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hands to kill us.

title: Exodus 5:22
text: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, Lord, why have You treated this people ill? Why then have you sent me?

title: Exodus 5:23
text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has done evil to this people. Neither have You delivered Your people at all.

title: Exodus 6:1
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand he shall let them go, and with a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.

title: Exodus 6:2
text: And God spoke to Moses, and said to him, I am Jehovah.

title: Exodus 6:3
text: And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob [as] God Almighty. But I was not known to them [by] the name JEHOVAH.

title: Exodus 6:4
text: And I also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.

title: Exodus 6:5
text: And I have also heard the groaning of the sons of Israel, those whom the Egyptians are keeping in bondage. And I have remembered My covenant.

title: Exodus 6:6
text: Therefore say to the sons of Israel, I [am] Jehovah, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rescue you out of their bondage. And I will redeem you with a stretched-out arm, and with great judgments.

title: Exodus 6:7
text: And I will take you to Me for a people, and I will be to you a God. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 6:8
text: And I will bring you in to the land concerning which I lifted up My hand to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob. And I will give it to you for a heritage. I [am] the LORD!

title: Exodus 6:9
text: And Moses said so to the sons of Israel. But they did not listen to Moses through shortness of spirit and through cruel bondage.

title: Exodus 6:10
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 6:11
text: Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the sons of Israel go out of his land.

title: Exodus 6:12
text: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, Behold, the sons of Israel have not listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh hear me, since I have lips that are not circumcised?

title: Exodus 6:13
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a charge to the sons of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 6:14
text: These [were] the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These [were] the families of Reuben.

title: Exodus 6:15
text: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanitess. These [were] the families of Simeon.

title: Exodus 6:16
text: And these [were] the names of the sons of Levi, according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi [were] a hundred and thirty-seven years.

title: Exodus 6:17
text: The sons of Gershon: Libni, and Shimei, by their families.

title: Exodus 6:18
text: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath [were] a hundred and thirty-three years.

title: Exodus 6:19
text: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These [were] the families of Levi according to their generations.

title: Exodus 6:20
text: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, for his wife. And she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram [were] a hundred and thirty-seven years.

title: Exodus 6:21
text: And the sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

title: Exodus 6:22
text: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

title: Exodus 6:23
text: And Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, for his wife. And she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

title: Exodus 6:24
text: And the sons of Korah [were] Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These [were] the families of the Korahites.

title: Exodus 6:25
text: And Aaron's son Eleazar took his wife of the daughters of Putiel. And she bore him Phinehas. These [were] the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

title: Exodus 6:26
text: It [was] Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, Bring out the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

title: Exodus 6:27
text: These [were] the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring out the sons of Israel from Egypt. It was Moses and Aaron.

title: Exodus 6:28
text: And it happened on the day the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt:

title: Exodus 6:29
text: the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, I [am] the LORD. You speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you.

title: Exodus 6:30
text: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I [am] of uncircumcised lips, and how [shall] Pharaoh listen to me?

title: Exodus 7:1
text: And the LORD said to Moses, See, I have made you a god to Pharaoh. And Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

title: Exodus 7:2
text: You shall speak all that I command you. And Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, he will send the sons of Israel out of his land.

title: Exodus 7:3
text: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart and multiply My signs and My wonders in the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 7:4
text: But Pharaoh shall not listen to you, and I will lay My hand upon Egypt, and bring My armies, My people the sons of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

title: Exodus 7:5
text: And the Egyptians shall know that I [am] the LORD when I stretch forth My hand upon Egypt, and bring out the sons of Israel from among them.

title: Exodus 7:6
text: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them; so they did.

title: Exodus 7:7
text: And Moses [was] eighty years old, and Aaron [was] eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

title: Exodus 7:8
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying:

title: Exodus 7:9
text: When Pharaoh shall speak to you saying, Give a miracle for yourselves, you shall say to Aaron, Take your rod, and throw [it] in front of Pharaoh. It shall become a snake.

title: Exodus 7:10
text: And Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh. And they did so, as the LORD had commanded. And Aaron threw down his rod in front of Pharaoh and in front of his servants, and it became a snake.

title: Exodus 7:11
text: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers. And they, the priests of Egypt, did the same with their secret arts.

title: Exodus 7:12
text: For each man threw down his rod, and they became snakes. But Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

title: Exodus 7:13
text: And He hardened Pharaoh's heart so that he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.

title: Exodus 7:14
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh's heart [is] hardened. He refuses to let the people go.

title: Exodus 7:15
text: You go to Pharaoh in the morning. Lo, he goes out to the water. And you shall stand by the river's brink until he comes. And you shall take in your hand the rod which was turned to a snake.

title: Exodus 7:16
text: And you shall say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews has sent me to you, saying, Let My people go so that they may serve Me in the wilderness. And, behold, until now you would not hear.

title: Exodus 7:17
text: Thus says the LORD, In this you shall know that I [am] the LORD. Behold! I will smite with the rod that [is] in my hand upon the waters in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

title: Exodus 7:18
text: And the fish in the river shall die, and the river shall stink. And the Egyptians shall hate to drink of the water of the river.

title: Exodus 7:19
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron, Take your rod, and stretch out your hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their canals, and upon their pools, and upon every reservoir of their waters, [that] they may become blood. And blood shall be throughout all the land of Egypt, both in wooden and in stone [vessels].

title: Exodus 7:20
text: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded. And he lifted up the rod and struck the waters that [were] in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of his servants. And all the waters in the river were turned to blood.

title: Exodus 7:21
text: And the fish in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river. And there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 7:22
text: And the priests of Egypt did so with their secret arts. And Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.

title: Exodus 7:23
text: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house; And he did not set his heart to this also.

title: Exodus 7:24
text: And all the Egyptians dug all around the river for water to drink, for they could not drink of the water of the river.

title: Exodus 7:25
text: And seven days were completed after the LORD had stricken the river.

title: Exodus 8:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Go to Pharaoh, and say to him: Thus says the LORD, Let my people go so that they may serve Me.

title: Exodus 8:2
text: And if you refuse to let [them] go, behold, I [am] going to strike all your borders [with] frogs.

title: Exodus 8:3
text: And the river shall bring forth frogs plentifully, which shall go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and upon your bed, and into the house of your servants, and upon your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

title: Exodus 8:4
text: And the frogs shall come upon you, and upon your people, and upon all your servants.

title: Exodus 8:5
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron: Stretch out your hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 8:6
text: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 8:7
text: And the priests did so with their secret arts, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 8:8
text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Pray to the LORD that He may take away the frogs from me and from my people. And I will let the people go, so that they may sacrifice to the LORD.

title: Exodus 8:9
text: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Glory over me! When shall I pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, to destroy the frogs from you and your houses, so [that] they may remain in the river only?

title: Exodus 8:10
text: And he said, Tomorrow. And he said, It shall be according to your word, so that you may know that [there is] none like the LORD our God.

title: Exodus 8:11
text: And the frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.

title: Exodus 8:12
text: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh. And Moses cried to the LORD because of the frogs which He had brought against Pharaoh.

title: Exodus 8:13
text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses. And the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

title: Exodus 8:14
text: And they gathered them in heaps [and] heaps. And the land stank.

title: Exodus 8:15
text: But Pharaoh saw that [there] was relief, and he hardened his heart, and did not listen to them, even as the LORD had said.

title: Exodus 8:16
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Say to Aaron: Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the land, so that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 8:17
text: And they did so. For Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod and struck the dust of the earth. And it became lice in man and in beast. All the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 8:18
text: And the priests did so with their secret arts to bring forth lice, but they could not. So there were lice upon man and upon beast.

title: Exodus 8:19
text: And the priests said to Pharaoh, This [is] the finger of God. And Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he did not listen to them, as the LORD had said.

title: Exodus 8:20
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise up early in the morning and stand before Pharaoh. Lo, he comes forth to the water. And say to him, Thus says the LORD: Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

title: Exodus 8:21
text: And if you will not let My people go, behold, I will send swarms [of flies] on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your house. And the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms [of flies], and also the ground on which they [are].

title: Exodus 8:22
text: And in that day I will cut off the land of Goshen, in which My people live, so that no swarms [of flies] shall be there, so that you may know that I [am] Jehovah in the midst of the earth.

title: Exodus 8:23
text: And I will put a dividing line between My people and your people. This miracle shall be tomorrow.

title: Exodus 8:24
text: And the LORD did so. And teeming swarms [of flies] came into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt. The land was destroyed because of the swarms.

title: Exodus 8:25
text: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go sacrifice to your God in the land.

title: Exodus 8:26
text: And Moses said, It is not right to do so, for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God. Lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

title: Exodus 8:27
text: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and. sacrifice to the LORD our God, as He shall command us.

title: Exodus 8:28
text: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go so that you may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness. Only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.

title: Exodus 8:29
text: And Moses said, Behold, I will go out from you, and I will pray to the LORD that the swarms [of flies] may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow. But do not let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

title: Exodus 8:30
text: And Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

title: Exodus 8:31
text: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses. And He removed the swarms from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

title: Exodus 8:32
text: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

title: Exodus 9:1
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh and tell him, Thus says the LORD God of the Hebrews: Let My people go so that they may serve Me.

title: Exodus 9:2
text: For if you refuse to let [them] go, and will hold them still,

title: Exodus 9:3
text: behold, the hand of the LORD is upon your cattle in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep, a very grievous plague.

title: Exodus 9:4
text: And the LORD shall separate between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt. And there shall nothing die of all [that belongs] to the sons of Israel.

title: Exodus 9:5
text: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, Tomorrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

title: Exodus 9:6
text: And the LORD did that thing on the next day, and all the cattle of Egypt died. But of the cattle of the sons of Israel, not one died.

title: Exodus 9:7
text: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

title: Exodus 9:8
text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, Take to yourselves handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

title: Exodus 9:9
text: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth [with] sores upon man and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 9:10
text: And they took ashes of the furnace and stood before Pharaoh. And Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky, and it became a boil breaking forth [with] sores upon man and upon beast.

title: Exodus 9:11
text: And the priests could not stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boil was upon the priests and upon all the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 9:12
text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he did not listen to them, even as the LORD had spoken to Moses.

title: Exodus 9:13
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say to him, So says the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

title: Exodus 9:14
text: For I [am] going to send at this time all My plagues upon your heart, and upon your servants, and upon your people, so that you may know that [there is] none like Me in all the earth.

title: Exodus 9:15
text: For now I will stretch out My hand, that I may strike you and your people with plagues, and you shall be cut off from the earth.

title: Exodus 9:16
text: And for this I have made you stand, to make you see My power, to declare My name in all the land.

title: Exodus 9:17
text: Do you still exalt yourself against My people, that you will not let them go?

title: Exodus 9:18
text: Behold! Tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, [such as] has not been in Egypt since the foundation of it even until now!

title: Exodus 9:19
text: And now send out, gather your cattle, and all that you have in the field. Upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

title: Exodus 9:20
text: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle to flee into the houses.

title: Exodus 9:21
text: And he that did not regard the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

title: Exodus 9:22
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch forth your hand toward heaven, so that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 9:23
text: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heavens. And the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire came down to the ground. And the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 9:24
text: And [there] was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

title: Exodus 9:25
text: And the hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that [was] in the field, both man and beast. And the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

title: Exodus 9:26
text: Only in the land of Goshen, where the sons of Israel [were], was there no hail.

title: Exodus 9:27
text: And Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, I have sinned [this] time. Jehovah [is] righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

title: Exodus 9:28
text: Pray to the LORD, [for it is] enough. Let there be no mighty thunderings and hail. And I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.

title: Exodus 9:29
text: And Moses said to him, as soon as I go out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands to the LORD. The thunder shall stop, and the hail will not be any more, so that you may know that the earth is the LORD's.

title: Exodus 9:30
text: But [as for] you and your servants, I know that you will not yet fear the LORD God.

title: Exodus 9:31
text: And the flax and the barley [were] stricken, for the barley was in the head, and the flax was in bud.

title: Exodus 9:32
text: But the wheat and the rye were not stricken, for they had not grown up.

title: Exodus 9:33
text: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands to the LORD. And the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

title: Exodus 9:34
text: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned still more and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

title: Exodus 9:35
text: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the sons of Israel go, even as the LORD had spoken by Moses.

title: Exodus 10:1
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, so that I might show these My signs before him,

title: Exodus 10:2
text: and so that you may tell in the ears of your son, and of your son's sons, what things I have worked in Egypt, and My signs which I have done among them, so that you may know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Exodus 10:3
text: And Moses and Aaron came in to Pharaoh and said to him, So says the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long will you refuse to humble yourself before Me? Let My people go, so that they may serve Me.

title: Exodus 10:4
text: For if you refuse to let My people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring the locusts into your coast.

title: Exodus 10:5
text: And they shall cover the face of the land, so that one cannot be able to see the earth. And they shall eat the rest of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

title: Exodus 10:6
text: And they shall fill your houses, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, which neither your fathers, nor your fathers' fathers have seen, since the day they were upon the earth until this day. And he turned himself and went out from Pharaoh.

title: Exodus 10:7
text: And Pharaoh's servants said to him, How long shall this man be a snare to us? Let the men go so that they may serve the LORD their God. Do you not yet know that Egypt is destroyed?

title: Exodus 10:8
text: And Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, Go! Serve the LORD your God. Who [are] the ones that shall go?

title: Exodus 10:9
text: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters. We will go with our flocks and with our herds. For we [must hold] a feast to the LORD.

title: Exodus 10:10
text: And he said to them, May the LORD be so with you, as I send you and your little ones away. Watch out, for evil [is] before you.

title: Exodus 10:11
text: Not so! You men go now and serve the LORD, for it is you who did desire it. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

title: Exodus 10:12
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt and eat every herb of the land, all that the hail has left.

title: Exodus 10:13
text: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day and all the night. When it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

title: Exodus 10:14
text: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt and rested in all the coasts of Egypt, very numerous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

title: Exodus 10:15
text: For they covered the face of the whole earth so that the land was darkened. And they ate every herb of the land and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. And there did not remain any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 10:16
text: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste. And he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

title: Exodus 10:17
text: And now please, forgive my sin only this once, and pray to the LORD your God, that He may take away from me this death only.

title: Exodus 10:18
text: And he went out from Pharaoh, and prayed [to] the LORD.

title: Exodus 10:19
text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts and threw them into the Red Sea. There did not remain one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

title: Exodus 10:20
text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he did not let the sons of Israel go.

title: Exodus 10:21
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand toward the heavens, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, so that one may even feel the darkness.

title: Exodus 10:22
text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven. And there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days.

title: Exodus 10:23
text: They did not see one another, nor did any rise from his place, [for] three days. But all the sons of Israel had light in their dwellings.

title: Exodus 10:24
text: And Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, You go serve the LORD. Only let your flocks and your herds be left. Let your little ones also go with you.

title: Exodus 10:25
text: And Moses said, You must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

title: Exodus 10:26
text: Our cattle also shall go with us. There shall not be a hoof left behind. For we must take from them to serve the LORD our God. And we do not know [with] what we must serve the LORD until we come there.

title: Exodus 10:27
text: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

title: Exodus 10:28
text: And Pharaoh said to him, Go away from me! Take heed to yourself; see my face no more. For in the day you see my face you shall die.

title: Exodus 10:29
text: And Moses said, You have spoken well. I will never see your face again.

title: Exodus 11:1
text: And the LORD said to Moses, I will still bring one plague yet on Pharaoh and on Egypt. Afterward he will let you go from here. When he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out from here altogether.

title: Exodus 11:2
text: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow from his neighbor, and every woman from her neighbor, articles of silver and jewels of gold.

title: Exodus 11:3
text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. And the man Moses [was] very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

title: Exodus 11:4
text: And Moses said, Thus says the LORD: About midnight I will go out into the midst of Egypt.

title: Exodus 11:5
text: And all the first-born in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first-born of Pharaoh that sits upon his throne, even to the first-born of the slave-girl that [is] behind the mill; also the first-born of beasts.

title: Exodus 11:6
text: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

title: Exodus 11:7
text: But against any of the sons of Israel not even a dog shall move his tongue, against man or beast, so that you may know that the LORD puts a difference [between] the Egyptians and Israel.

title: Exodus 11:8
text: And all these, your servants, shall come down to me and bow themselves down to me, saying, You and all the people that follow you get out. And after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

title: Exodus 11:9
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh shall not listen to you, so that My wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 11:10
text: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh. And the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart so that he would not let the sons of Israel go out of his land.

title: Exodus 12:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Exodus 12:2
text: This month [shall be] to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

title: Exodus 12:3
text: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth of this month they shall take to them each man a lamb for a father's house, a lamb for a house.

title: Exodus 12:4
text: And if the household is too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbor next to his house take according to the number of the souls, each one, according to the eating of his mouth, you shall count concerning the lamb.

title: Exodus 12:5
text: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year. You shall take from the sheep or from the goats.

title: Exodus 12:6
text: And you shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month. And the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

title: Exodus 12:7
text: And they shall take of the blood and strike on the two side posts and upon the upper door post of the houses [in] which they shall eat it.

title: Exodus 12:8
text: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened [bread]. They shall eat it with [bitter] herbs.

title: Exodus 12:9
text: Do not eat of it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted [with] fire, its head with its legs, and with its inward parts.

title: Exodus 12:10
text: And you shall not let any of it remain until the morning. And that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

title: Exodus 12:11
text: And you shall eat of it this way, [with] your loins girded, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. And you shall eat it in a hurry. It [is] the LORD's passover.

title: Exodus 12:12
text: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the first-born in the land of Egypt, both man and beast. And I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I [am] the LORD.

title: Exodus 12:13
text: And the blood shall be a sign to you upon the houses where you [are]. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you. And the plague shall not be upon you for a destruction when I smite in the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 12:14
text: And this day shall be a memorial to you. And you shall keep it as a feast to the LORD throughout your generations. You shall keep it [as] a feast by a law forever.

title: Exodus 12:15
text: You shall eat unleavened [bread] seven days; even the first day you shall put away leaven out of your houses. For whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

title: Exodus 12:16
text: And on the first day [shall be] a holy gathering, and in the seventh day there shall be a holy gathering for you. No manner of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, that only may be done by you.

title: Exodus 12:17
text: And you shall keep the [Feast of] Unleavened [Bread]. For in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall keep this day in your generations by a law forever.

title: Exodus 12:18
text: In the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened [bread], until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.

title: Exodus 12:19
text: Seven days there shall be no leaven found in your houses. For whoever eats that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, among the aliens and among the natives of the land.

title: Exodus 12:20
text: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your dwelling-places you shall eat unleavened [bread].

title: Exodus 12:21
text: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel and said to them, Draw out and take a lamb for yourselves according to your families, and kill the passover.

title: Exodus 12:22
text: And you shall take a bunch of hyssop and dip in the blood in the bowl, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood in the bowl. And none of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

title: Exodus 12:23
text: For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians. And when He sees the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come into your houses to strike you.

title: Exodus 12:24
text: And you shall observe this thing for a law to you and to your sons forever.

title: Exodus 12:25
text: And it shall be, when you have come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as He has promised, that you shall keep this service.

title: Exodus 12:26
text: And it will be, when your sons shall say to you, What is this service to you?

title: Exodus 12:27
text: Then you shall say, It [is] the sacrifice of the LORD's passover, who passed over the houses of the sons of Israel in Egypt, when He struck the Egyptians and delivered our houses. And the people bowed and worshiped.

title: Exodus 12:28
text: And the sons of Israel went away and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron; so they did.

title: Exodus 12:29
text: And it happened at midnight the LORD struck all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the first-born of Pharaoh that sat on his throne to the first-born of the captive that [was] in the prison; also all the first-born of cattle.

title: Exodus 12:30
text: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants, and all the Egyptians. And there was a great cry in Egypt, for [there was] not a house where there was not one dead.

title: Exodus 12:31
text: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up! Get away from my people, both you and the sons of Israel! And go serve the LORD, as you have said.

title: Exodus 12:32
text: Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and go. And bless me also.

title: Exodus 12:33
text: And the Egyptians were urging the people, that they might send them out of the land in a hurry. For they said, We [are] all dead.

title: Exodus 12:34
text: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading-troughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

title: Exodus 12:35
text: And the sons of Israel did according to the word of Moses. And they borrowed articles of silver, and articles of gold, and clothing from the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 12:36
text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and they granted their request, and they plundered the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 12:37
text: And the sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, the men being about six hundred thousand men on foot, apart from little ones.

title: Exodus 12:38
text: And also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks, and herds, very much cattle.

title: Exodus 12:39
text: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt, for it was not leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt and could not stay, neither had they prepared any food for a journey for themselves.

title: Exodus 12:40
text: And the time that the sons of Israel lived in Egypt [was] four hundred and thirty years.

title: Exodus 12:41
text: And it happened at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even it was on this very day, all the armies of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 12:42
text: It [is] a night to be much kept to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This [is] that night of the LORD to be kept by all the sons of Israel in their generations.

title: Exodus 12:43
text: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, This [is] the ordinance of the Passover. No stranger shall eat of it.

title: Exodus 12:44
text: But every man's servant that is bought for silver, when you have circumcised him, then he shall eat of it.

title: Exodus 12:45
text: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

title: Exodus 12:46
text: It shall be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the flesh out of the house. Neither shall you break a bone of it.

title: Exodus 12:47
text: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

title: Exodus 12:48
text: And when a stranger shall stay with you, and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. And he shall be as one that is born in the land. And no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

title: Exodus 12:49
text: There shall be one law to the native, and to the visitor that stays among you.

title: Exodus 12:50
text: So all the sons of Israel did. Even as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

title: Exodus 12:51
text: And it happened the very same day, [that] the LORD brought the sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

title: Exodus 13:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 13:2
text: Sanctify all the first-born to Me, whatever opens the womb among the sons of Israel, of man and of beast. It [is] Mine.

title: Exodus 13:3
text: And Moses said to the people, Remember this day [in] which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. For the LORD brought you out from this place by the strength of His hand. There shall be no leavened bread eaten.

title: Exodus 13:4
text: You are going out this day in the month Abib.

title: Exodus 13:5
text: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which He swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

title: Exodus 13:6
text: You shall eat unleavened [bread] seven days, and in the seventh day [shall be] a feast to the LORD.

title: Exodus 13:7
text: Unleavened [bread] shall be eaten seven days. And there shall be no leavened [bread] seen with you, nor shall there be leaven seen with you in all your borders.

title: Exodus 13:8
text: And you shall tell your son in that day, saying, This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out from Egypt.

title: Exodus 13:9
text: And it shall be a sign to you upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD's law may be in your mouth. For the Lord has brought you out of Egypt with a strong hand.

title: Exodus 13:10
text: You shall therefore keep this law in its season from year to year.

title: Exodus 13:11
text: And it will be, when the LORD shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, as He swore to you and to your fathers, and shall give it to you,

title: Exodus 13:12
text: you shall set apart to the LORD every one that opens the womb, and every first-born that comes of any animal which you have; the males [shall be] the LORD's.

title: Exodus 13:13
text: And every first-born of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb. And if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. And all the first-born of man among your sons you shall redeem.

title: Exodus 13:14
text: And it shall be when your sons asks you in time to come, saying, What [is] this? you shall say to him, The LORD brought us out of Egypt by the strength of [His] hand, from the house of bondage.

title: Exodus 13:15
text: And it happened when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, the LORD killed all the first-born of the land of Egypt, both the first-born of man, and the first-born of animals. Therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that opens the womb, that are males. But all the first-born of my sons I redeem.

title: Exodus 13:16
text: And it shall be for a token upon your hand, and for frontlets between your eyes. For the LORD brought us out from Egypt by strength of [His] hand.

title: Exodus 13:17
text: And it happened, when Pharaoh had let the people go, God did not lead them [by] the way of the land of the Philistines although that [was] near. For God said, Lest the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt.

title: Exodus 13:18
text: But God led the people around, [by] the way of the wilderness of the Red Sea. And the sons of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 13:19
text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him. For he had strictly sworn the sons of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and you shall carry my bones away from here with you.

title: Exodus 13:20
text: And they moved from Succoth and camped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

title: Exodus 13:21
text: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the right away, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, to go by day and night.

title: Exodus 13:22
text: He did not take away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, [from] before the people.

title: Exodus 14:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 14:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel that they turn and camp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon. You shall camp before [it], by the sea.

title: Exodus 14:3
text: For Pharaoh will say of the sons of Israel, They [are] tangled in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.

title: Exodus 14:4
text: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he will follow them. And I will be honored upon Pharaoh, and upon all his army, so that the Egyptians may know that I [am] the LORD. And they did so.

title: Exodus 14:5
text: And the king of Egypt was told that the people fled. And the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people. And they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

title: Exodus 14:6
text: And he made his chariot ready, and took his people with him.

title: Exodus 14:7
text: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

title: Exodus 14:8
text: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And he pursued the sons of Israel, and the sons of Israel went out with a high hand.

title: Exodus 14:9
text: But the Egyptians pursued them, all the horses [and] chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army. And they overtook them camping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

title: Exodus 14:10
text: And Pharaoh drew near, the sons of Israel lifted up their eyes. And, behold, the Egyptians marched after them. And they were very afraid. And the sons of Israel cried out to the LORD.

title: Exodus 14:11
text: And they said to Moses, Have you taken us away to die in the wilderness because [there were] no graves in Egypt? Why have you dealt this way with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

title: Exodus 14:12
text: Did we not tell you this word in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, so that we may serve the Egyptians? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

title: Exodus 14:13
text: And Moses said to the people, Do not fear. Stand still and see the salvation of the LORD, which He will prepare for you this day. For the Egyptians whom you have seen today, you shall never see them anymore.

title: Exodus 14:14
text: The LORD shall fight for you, and you shall be silent.

title: Exodus 14:15
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Why do you cry to Me? Speak to the sons of Israel, that they go forward.

title: Exodus 14:16
text: But lift up your rod and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it. And the sons of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

title: Exodus 14:17
text: And behold! I [am] about to harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them. And I will get honor for Me upon Pharaoh, and upon all his army, upon his chariots and upon his horsemen.

title: Exodus 14:18
text: And the Egyptians shall know that I [am] the LORD when I have gotten honor for Me upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

title: Exodus 14:19
text: And the Angel of God, the one who went before the camp of Israel, moved. And he went to the rear of them. And the pillar of the cloud went from in front of their face and it stood behind them.

title: Exodus 14:20
text: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel. And it was a cloudy and dark night, but it gave light to the night, so that the one did not come near the other all night.

title: Exodus 14:21
text: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea. And the LORD caused the sea to recede by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

title: Exodus 14:22
text: And the sons of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground. And the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

title: Exodus 14:23
text: And the Egyptians pursued and went after them to the middle of the sea, all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

title: Exodus 14:24
text: And in the morning watch it happened that the LORD looked to the army of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the army of the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 14:25
text: And He took off their chariot wheels, and made them go heavily, so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel, for the LORD fights for them against the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 14:26
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

title: Exodus 14:27
text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea. And the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared. And the Egyptians fled against it. And the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

title: Exodus 14:28
text: And the waters returned and covered the chariots and the horsemen, all the army of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them. There did not remain so much as one of them.

title: Exodus 14:29
text: But the sons of Israel walked upon dry land in the middle of the sea. And the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

title: Exodus 14:30
text: So the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians. And Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the seashore.

title: Exodus 14:31
text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians. And the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD and His servant Moses.

title: Exodus 15:1
text: Then the sons of Moses and Israel sang this song to the LORD, and spoke, saying, I will sing to the LORD, for He has triumphed gloriously; [the] horse and his rider He has thrown into the sea.

title: Exodus 15:2
text: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will glorify Him, my father's God, and I will exalt Him.

title: Exodus 15:3
text: The LORD [is] a Man of war; Jehovah [is] His name.

title: Exodus 15:4
text: Pharaoh's chariots and his army He has thrown into the sea; his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red Sea.

title: Exodus 15:5
text: The depths have covered them; they sank into the bottom like a stone.

title: Exodus 15:6
text: Your right hand, O LORD, has become glorious in power. Your right hand, O LORD, has dashed the enemy in pieces.

title: Exodus 15:7
text: And in the greatness of Your excellency You have overthrown them that rose up against You. You sent forth Your wrath, consuming them like stubble.

title: Exodus 15:8
text: And with the blast of Your nostrils the waters were gathered together; the floods stood upright like a heap; the depths were curdled in the heart of the sea.

title: Exodus 15:9
text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them, I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

title: Exodus 15:10
text: You blew with Your wind; the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

title: Exodus 15:11
text: Who [is] like You, O LORD, among the gods? Who [is] like You, glorious in holiness, fearful [in] praises, doing wonders?

title: Exodus 15:12
text: You stretched out Your right hand, the earth swallowed them.

title: Exodus 15:13
text: You in Your mercy have led forth the people [which] You have redeemed. You have guided them in Your strength to Your holy habitation.

title: Exodus 15:14
text: The people shall hear, being afraid. Sorrow shall take hold on the people of Philistia.

title: Exodus 15:15
text: Then the princes of Edom [were] terrified. Trembling seized upon the mighty men of Moab. All the people of Canaan shall melt away.

title: Exodus 15:16
text: Fear and dread shall fall upon them. By the greatness of Your arm they shall be still as a stone, until Your people pass over, O LORD; until the people [whom] You have purchased pass over.

title: Exodus 15:17
text: You shall bring them and plant them in the mountain of Your inheritance, the place, O LORD, You have made for You to dwell in; the Sanctuary, O LORD, [which] Your hands have established.

title: Exodus 15:18
text: The LORD shall reign forever and ever.

title: Exodus 15:19
text: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them. But the sons of Israel went on dry land in the middle of the sea.

title: Exodus 15:20
text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand. And all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

title: Exodus 15:21
text: And Miriam answered them, Sing to the LORD, for He has triumphed gloriously. The horse and his rider He has thrown into the sea.

title: Exodus 15:22
text: And Moses brought Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur. And they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

title: Exodus 15:23
text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, because it [was] bitter. Therefore the name of it was called Marah.

title: Exodus 15:24
text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

title: Exodus 15:25
text: And he cried to the LORD. And the LORD showed him a tree. And when he had cast it into the waters, the waters were made sweet. There He made a decree and a law for them, and there He tested them.

title: Exodus 15:26
text: And he said, If you will carefully listen to the voice of the LORD your God, and will do that which is right in His sight, and will give ear to His commandments, and keep all His laws, I will put none of these diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians; for I [am] the LORD who heals you.

title: Exodus 15:27
text: And they came to Elim, where [there were] twelve wells of water, and seventy palm trees. And they camped there by the waters.

title: Exodus 16:1
text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the sons of Israel came into the wilderness of Sin, which [is] between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month [after] their departing out of the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 16:2
text: And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

title: Exodus 16:3
text: And the sons of Israel said to them, O that we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh-pots, when we ate bread to the full! For you have brought us forth into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

title: Exodus 16:4
text: Then the LORD said to Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from the heavens for you. And the people shall go out and gather a certain amount every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in My law or not.

title: Exodus 16:5
text: And on the sixth day it shall happen, they shall prepare what they bring in. And it shall be twice as much as they gather day by day.

title: Exodus 16:6
text: And Moses and Aaron said to all the sons of Israel, At evening, then you shall know that the LORD has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 16:7
text: And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of the LORD. For He hears your murmurings against the LORD. And what [are] we, that you murmur against us?

title: Exodus 16:8
text: And Moses said, You will see when the LORD shall give you flesh to eat in the evening and bread to the full in the morning, when the LORD hears your murmurings which you murmur against Him. And what are we? Your murmurings [are] not against us, but against the LORD.

title: Exodus 16:9
text: And Moses spoke to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, Come near before the LORD. For He has heard your murmurings.

title: Exodus 16:10
text: And it happened as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, they turned toward the wilderness. And behold! The glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud!

title: Exodus 16:11
text: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 16:12
text: I have heard the murmurings of the sons of Israel. Speak to them, saying, You shall eat flesh at evening, and in the morning you shall be filled [with] bread. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Exodus 16:13
text: And it happened at evening, the quails came up and covered the camp. And in the morning the dew lay all around the host.

title: Exodus 16:14
text: And when the layer of dew had gone up, behold, [there was] a small round thing upon the face of the wilderness, small as the hoar-frost upon the ground.

title: Exodus 16:15
text: And when the sons of Israel saw, they said each one to his brother, What [is] that? For they did not know what it [was]. And Moses said to them, This [is] the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

title: Exodus 16:16
text: This [is] the thing which the LORD has commanded: Each man gather of it according to his eating, an omer for a head, according to the number of your souls. Each one shall take for those who [are] in his camp.

title: Exodus 16:17
text: And the sons of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, and some less.

title: Exodus 16:18
text: And when they measured with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little lacked nothing. They gathered each one according to his eating.

title: Exodus 16:19
text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it until the morning.

title: Exodus 16:20
text: But they did not listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning. And it became rotten [with] maggots, and stank. And Moses was angry with them.

title: Exodus 16:21
text: And they gathered it every morning, each man according to his eating. And when the sun became hot, it melted.

title: Exodus 16:22
text: And it happened, on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one. And all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

title: Exodus 16:23
text: And he said to them, This [is that] which the LORD has said, Tomorrow is the rest of the holy sabbath to the LORD. Bake what you will bake [today], and boil what you will boil. And that which remains over, lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

title: Exodus 16:24
text: And they laid it up until the morning, as Moses said. And it did not stink, neither was there any worm in it.

title: Exodus 16:25
text: And Moses said, Eat that today. For today [is] a sabbath to the LORD. Today you shall not find it in the field.

title: Exodus 16:26
text: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

title: Exodus 16:27
text: And it happened [some] of the people went out on the seventh day in order to gather. And they did not find [any].

title: Exodus 16:28
text: And the LORD said to Moses, How long do you refuse to keep My commandments and My laws?

title: Exodus 16:29
text: See, because the LORD has given you the sabbath, therefore He gives you the bread of two days on the sixth day. Each one stay in his place. Let not any one go out of his place on the seventh day.

title: Exodus 16:30
text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

title: Exodus 16:31
text: And the house of Israel called the name of it Manna. And it [was] like coriander seed, white. And the taste of it [was] like wafers with honey.

title: Exodus 16:32
text: And Moses said, This [is] the thing which the LORD has commanded: Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations, so that you may see the bread with which I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

title: Exodus 16:33
text: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a pot and put an omer full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

title: Exodus 16:34
text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

title: Exodus 16:35
text: And the sons of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to a land in which people lived. They ate manna until they came into the borders of the land of Canaan.

title: Exodus 16:36
text: And an omer [is] the tenth part of an ephah.

title: Exodus 17:1
text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the command of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim. And [there was] no water for the people to drink.

title: Exodus 17:2
text: And the people wrangled with Moses and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said to them, Why do you wrangle with me? Why do you tempt the LORD?

title: Exodus 17:3
text: And the people thirsted there for water. And the people murmured against Moses and said, Why [is] this, [that] You brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our sons and our cattle with thirst?

title: Exodus 17:4
text: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, What shall I do to this people? They are almost ready to stone me.

title: Exodus 17:5
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Go on in front of the people, and take with you the elders of Israel. And take your rod with which you struck the river, in your hand, and go.

title: Exodus 17:6
text: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb. And you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, so that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

title: Exodus 17:7
text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the wrangling of the sons of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us or not?

title: Exodus 17:8
text: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

title: Exodus 17:9
text: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

title: Exodus 17:10
text: And Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek. And Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

title: Exodus 17:11
text: And it happened when Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. And when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

title: Exodus 17:12
text: But Moses' hands [became] heavy. And they took a stone and put [it] under him, and he sat on it. And Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. And his hands were steady until the going of the sun.

title: Exodus 17:13
text: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people by the mouth of the sword.

title: Exodus 17:14
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this, a memorial in a book, and set [it] in the ears of Joshua, that I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heavens.

title: Exodus 17:15
text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah My Banner.

title: Exodus 17:16
text: And he said, A hand [is] on the throne of the LORD; war is to the LORD with Amalek from generation to generation.

title: Exodus 18:1
text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt,

title: Exodus 18:2
text: then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

title: Exodus 18:3
text: and her two sons, of which the name of the one [was] Gershom (for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land),

title: Exodus 18:4
text: and the name of the other [was] Eliezer (for the God of my father, my help, delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.)

title: Exodus 18:5
text: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses in the wilderness, where he camped at the mount of God.

title: Exodus 18:6
text: And he said to Moses, I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you, and your wife and her two sons with her.

title: Exodus 18:7
text: And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed down to him, and kissed him. And they asked each other of [their] welfare. And they came into the tent.

title: Exodus 18:8
text: And Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel's sake, all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and [how] the LORD delivered them.

title: Exodus 18:9
text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom He had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 18:10
text: And Jethro said, Blessed [be] the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

title: Exodus 18:11
text: Now I know that Jehovah [is] greater than all gods; for in the thing in which they were proved against them.

title: Exodus 18:12
text: And Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. And Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.

title: Exodus 18:13
text: And on the next day it happened that Moses sat to judge the people. And the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.

title: Exodus 18:14
text: And when Moses' father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What [is] this thing which you do to the people? Why do you sit alone by yourself, and all the people stand by you from morning to evening?

title: Exodus 18:15
text: And Moses said to his father-in-law, Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

title: Exodus 18:16
text: When they have a matter, they come to me. And I judge between one and another, and I make known the statutes of God and His laws.

title: Exodus 18:17
text: And Moses' father-in-law said to him, The thing that you do [is] not good.

title: Exodus 18:18
text: You will surely wear away, both you and this people that [is] with you. For this thing [is] too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it alone.

title: Exodus 18:19
text: Listen now to my voice; I will give you counsel, and God will be with you. You be for the people toward God, that you may bring the causes to God.

title: Exodus 18:20
text: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall make them know the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

title: Exodus 18:21
text: And you shall look out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness. And place [such] over them to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

title: Exodus 18:22
text: And let them judge the people at all times. And it shall be, every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge. And make it easier for yourself, and they shall bear with you.

title: Exodus 18:23
text: If you will do this thing, and God command you, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

title: Exodus 18:24
text: And Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

title: Exodus 18:25
text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

title: Exodus 18:26
text: And they judged the people at all times. The hard causes they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
