text: You shall not slaughter the blood of My sacrifice on leavened [bread]. Neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the Passover be left to the morning.

title: Exodus 34:26
text: The first of the first-fruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

title: Exodus 34:27
text: And the LORD said to Moses, Write these words for yourself; for on the mouth of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.

title: Exodus 34:28
text: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights. He neither ate bread, nor drank water. And He wrote upon the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.

title: Exodus 34:29
text: And it happened as Moses was going down from the mountain of Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony being in Moses' hand as he went down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the skin of his face had become luminous through His speaking with him.

title: Exodus 34:30
text: And Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, and behold, the skin of his face had become luminous. And they were afraid to come near him.

title: Exodus 34:31
text: And Moses called to them. And Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him, and Moses talked with them.

title: Exodus 34:32
text: And afterward all the sons of Israel came near. And he commanded them all that the LORD had spoken with him in Mount Sinai.

title: Exodus 34:33
text: And Moses finished speaking with them, and he put a veil on his face.

title: Exodus 34:34
text: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with Him, he took the veil off until he came out. And he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel that which he was commanded.

title: Exodus 34:35
text: And the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face had become luminous. And Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with Him.

title: Exodus 35:1
text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the sons of Israel together and said to them, These [are] the words which the LORD has commanded, to do them.

title: Exodus 35:2
text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does work in it shall be put to death.

title: Exodus 35:3
text: You shall kindle no fire throughout your living places upon the Sabbath day.

title: Exodus 35:4
text: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel saying, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded. He said,

title: Exodus 35:5
text: Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever [is] of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD: gold, and silver, and bronze,

title: Exodus 35:6
text: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached [linen], and goats' [hair],

title: Exodus 35:7
text: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and acacia-wood,

title: Exodus 35:8
text: and oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

title: Exodus 35:9
text: and onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

title: Exodus 35:10
text: And every wise-hearted one among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

title: Exodus 35:11
text: the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets.

title: Exodus 35:12
text: And make the ark and the staves of it, the mercy-seat, and the veil of the covering,

title: Exodus 35:13
text: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and showbread,

title: Exodus 35:14
text: also the lampstand for the light, and its vessels, and its lamp, with the oil for the light,

title: Exodus 35:15
text: and the incense altar, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging of the door at the entering in of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 35:16
text: And make the altar of burnt offering, with its bronze grate, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,

title: Exodus 35:17
text: the hangings of the court, its pillars and their sockets, and the hanging, for the door of the court,

title: Exodus 35:18
text: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

title: Exodus 35:19
text: the woven garments to do service in the holy [place], the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 35:20
text: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

title: Exodus 35:21
text: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom His spirit made willing. They brought the LORD's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all His service, and for the holy garments.

title: Exodus 35:22
text: And the men came in together with the women, as many as were willing-hearted, bringing bracelets and earrings, and rings and ornaments, all jewels of gold. And everyone who offered waved a wave offering of gold to the LORD.

title: Exodus 35:23
text: And everyone [with] whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached [linen], and goats' [hair], and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

title: Exodus 35:24
text: Everyone lifting up an offering of silver and bronze brought the LORD's offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia-wood for any work of the service, brought [it].

title: Exodus 35:25
text: And every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands. And they brought spun yarn, blue, and purple, scarlet, and bleached [linen].

title: Exodus 35:26
text: And all the women whose hearts were lifted up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

title: Exodus 35:27
text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breast-pocket.

title: Exodus 35:28
text: And they brought spice and oil, for the light and for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense.

title: Exodus 35:29
text: The sons of Israel brought a willing offering to the LORD, every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all kinds of work which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

title: Exodus 35:30
text: And Moses said to the sons of Israel, See, the LORD has called the son of Uri the son of Hur, by the name Bezaleel, of the tribe of Judah.

title: Exodus 35:31
text: And He has filled him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of work,

title: Exodus 35:32
text: and to devise designs, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

title: Exodus 35:33
text: and in the cutting of stones to set, and in carving of wood, to make any kind of skillful work.

title: Exodus 35:34
text: And He has put in his heart that he may teach, he and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

title: Exodus 35:35
text: He has filled them [with] wisdom of heart to work all kinds of work; of the smith, and of the skillful worker, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in bleached [linen], and of the weaver, of those who do any work, and of those who work out artful work.

title: Exodus 36:1
text: And Bezaleel and Aholiab shall work with everyone wise of heart to whom the LORD has given wisdom and intelligence, to know how to do every work of the service of the sanctuary, concerning all which the LORD had commanded.

title: Exodus 36:2
text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise-hearted man in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come, to do the work.

title: Exodus 36:3
text: And they received all the offerings from Moses, the offering which the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it. And they still brought to him free offerings every morning.

title: Exodus 36:4
text: And all the wise men who worked all the work of the sanctuary came, every man from his work which they made.

title: Exodus 36:5
text: And they spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough [for] the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.

title: Exodus 36:6
text: And Moses commanded, and they caused it to be known throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. And the people were kept from bringing.

title: Exodus 36:7
text: For the stuff which they had was enough for all the work to make it, and too much.

title: Exodus 36:8
text: And every wise-hearted one among them that worked the work of the tabernacle, made ten curtains [of] fine twined bleached [linen], and blue, and purple, and scarlet. He made them with cherubs of skillful work.

title: Exodus 36:9
text: The length of one curtain [was] twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain was four cubits. The curtains were all of one size.

title: Exodus 36:10
text: And he coupled the five curtains to one another, and he coupled [the other] five curtains to one another.

title: Exodus 36:11
text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made loops in the outermost side, in the coupling of the second curtain.

title: Exodus 36:12
text: He made fifty loops in one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which [was] in the coupling of the second. The loops held one to another.

title: Exodus 36:13
text: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps. And it became one tabernacle.

title: Exodus 36:14
text: And he made curtains [of] goats' [hair] for the tent over the tabernacle. He made eleven curtains.

title: Exodus 36:15
text: The length of one curtain [was] thirty cubits, and four cubits the breadth of one curtain. The eleven curtains were of one size.

title: Exodus 36:16
text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

title: Exodus 36:17
text: And he made fifty loops on the outermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and he made fifty loops upon the edge of the curtains which coupled the second.

title: Exodus 36:18
text: And he made fifty clasps [of] bronze to couple the tent together, so that it might be one.

title: Exodus 36:19
text: And he made a covering for the tent [of] rams' skins dyed red, and a covering [of] dugong skins above.

title: Exodus 36:20
text: And he made boards for the tabernacle [of] acacia-wood, standing up.

title: Exodus 36:21
text: The length of a board [was] ten cubits, and the breadth of a board was one and a half cubits.

title: Exodus 36:22
text: By two pins the one board was connected, one to another. So he made for all the boards of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 36:23
text: And he made boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

title: Exodus 36:24
text: And he made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under one board for its two pins, and two sockets under another board for its two pins.

title: Exodus 36:25
text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, toward the north, he made twenty boards,

title: Exodus 36:26
text: and their forty sockets were of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

title: Exodus 36:27
text: And he made six boards for the sides of the tabernacle westward.

title: Exodus 36:28
text: And he made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the sides.

title: Exodus 36:29
text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head of it, to one ring. So he did to both of them in both the corners.

title: Exodus 36:30
text: And there were eight boards. And their sockets [were] sixteen sockets of silver, two sockets under every board.

title: Exodus 36:31
text: And he made bars of acacia-wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

title: Exodus 36:32
text: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the westward sides.

title: Exodus 36:33
text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

title: Exodus 36:34
text: And he overlaid the boards [with] gold, and made their rings [of] gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars [with] gold.

title: Exodus 36:35
text: And he made a veil [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen]. He made it the work of an artisan, with cherubs.

title: Exodus 36:36
text: And he made for it four pillars [of] acacia. And he overlaid them [with] gold. Their hooks [were of] gold, and he cast four sockets of silver for them.

title: Exodus 36:37
text: And he made a screen for the tabernacle door, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen], of needlework;

title: Exodus 36:38
text: and the five pillars of it, and their hooks. And he overlaid their capitals and their fillets [with] gold, but their five sockets [were of] bronze.

title: Exodus 37:1
text: And Bezaleel made the ark [of] acacia-wood: two cubits and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

title: Exodus 37:2
text: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold inside and out, and made a crown of gold around it.

title: Exodus 37:3
text: And he cast four rings of gold for it, for the corners of it, even two rings on the one side of it and two rings on the other side of it.

title: Exodus 37:4
text: And he made staves [of] acacia-wood and overlaid them [with] gold.

title: Exodus 37:5
text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, in order to bear the ark.

title: Exodus 37:6
text: And he made the mercy-seat [of] pure gold. Two cubits and a half long, and one cubit and a half wide.

title: Exodus 37:7
text: And he made two cherubs [of] gold on the two ends of the mercy-seat. He made them of beaten work,

title: Exodus 37:8
text: one cherub here at one end, and one cherub there at the [other] end. He made the cherubs out of the mercy-seat on the two ends of it.

title: Exodus 37:9
text: And the cherubs were spreading out [their] wings above, covering the mercy-seat [with] their wings, their faces each toward the other. The faces of the cherubs were toward the mercy-seat.

title: Exodus 37:10
text: And he made the table [of] acacia-wood. Two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

title: Exodus 37:11
text: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold, and made for it a crown of gold all around.

title: Exodus 37:12
text: Also he made for it a border all around, of a hand's breadth. And he made a crown of gold for the border of it all around.

title: Exodus 37:13
text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that [were] in the four feet of it.

title: Exodus 37:14
text: The rings were near the border, the housings for the staves to carry the table.

title: Exodus 37:15
text: And he made the staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlaid them [with] gold, to carry the table.

title: Exodus 37:16
text: And he made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes and its spoons, and its bowls, and its pitchers by which a drink offering is made, [of] pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:17
text: And he made the lampstand [of] pure gold. He made the lampstand [of] beaten work; its shaft and its branch, its cups, its knobs, and its blossoms, were of the same.

title: Exodus 37:18
text: And six branches went out of the sides of it; three branches of the lampstand out of the one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side of it.

title: Exodus 37:19
text: Three almond-like cups [were] on the one branch, a knob and a blossom; and three almond-like cups on the one branch, a knob and a blossom. So throughout the six branches going out of the lampstand.

title: Exodus 37:20
text: And on the lampstand [were] four almond-like cups, its knobs and its blossoms.

title: Exodus 37:21
text: And a knob was under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, to the six branches going out of it.

title: Exodus 37:22
text: Their knobs and their branches were of the same; all of it was one beaten work [of] pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:23
text: And he made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, [of] pure gold.

title: Exodus 37:24
text: He made it of a talent [of] pure gold, and all the vessels of it.

title: Exodus 37:25
text: And he made the incense altar [of] acacia-wood. Its length was a cubit, and its breadth a cubit, square. And its height was two cubits. Its horns were of the same.

title: Exodus 37:26
text: And he overlaid it [with] pure gold, the top of it and the sides of it all around, and the horns of it. Also he made for it a crown of gold all around.

title: Exodus 37:27
text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown of it, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides of it, to be places for the staves to bear it with.

title: Exodus 37:28
text: And he made the staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlaid them [with] gold.

title: Exodus 37:29
text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, the work of the perfumer.

title: Exodus 38:1
text: And he made the altar of burnt offering [of] acacia-wood. Its length [was] five cubits, and its breadth five cubits, square; and its height three cubits.

title: Exodus 38:2
text: And he made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of it. And he overlaid it [with] bronze.

title: Exodus 38:3
text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, the flesh-hooks, and the fire-pans. All the vessels of it he made [of] bronze.

title: Exodus 38:4
text: And he made a bronze grate of network for the altar, under the compass of it, beneath to the middle of it.

title: Exodus 38:5
text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of bronze, places for the staves.

title: Exodus 38:6
text: And he made the staves [of] acacia-wood and overlaid them [with] bronze.

title: Exodus 38:7
text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with. He made it hollow [with] boards.

title: Exodus 38:8
text: And he made the laver [of] bronze, and its base bronze, out of the mirrors of serving women who assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Exodus 38:9
text: And he made the court. On the south side southward the hangings of the court [were of] fine twined bleached [linen], a hundred cubits.

title: Exodus 38:10
text: Their pillars were twenty, and their bronze sockets twenty. The hooks of the pillar and their bands [were of] silver.

title: Exodus 38:11
text: And for the north side, a hundred by the cubit, their pillars twenty, and their twenty sockets bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.

title: Exodus 38:12
text: And for the west side [were] hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.

title: Exodus 38:13
text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

title: Exodus 38:14
text: The hangings of the one side [were] fifteen cubits, and their pillars three, and their sockets three.

title: Exodus 38:15
text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, [were] hangings of fifteen cubits, their pillars three, and their sockets three.

title: Exodus 38:16
text: All the hangings of the court all around [were] of fine twined bleached [linen].

title: Exodus 38:17
text: And the sockets for the pillars were [of] bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands were [of] silver. And the overlaying of their capitals was [of] silver. And all the pillars of the court were banded with silver.

title: Exodus 38:18
text: And the screen for the gate of the court [was] needlework: blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen]. And it was twenty cubits long, and the height and the width five cubits, to match the hangings of the court.

title: Exodus 38:19
text: And the pillars [were] four, and their bronze sockets four; their hooks silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their bands silver.

title: Exodus 38:20
text: And all the pins of the tabernacle and of the court all around, [were of] bronze.

title: Exodus 38:21
text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the command of Moses, [for] the service of the Levites by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

title: Exodus 38:22
text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 38:23
text: And with him [was] Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue and in purple and in scarlet and bleached [linen].

title: Exodus 38:24
text: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

title: Exodus 38:25
text: And the silver from those numbered of the congregation [was] a hundred talents, and seventeen hundred seventy-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;

title: Exodus 38:26
text: a bekah for every man, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand, five hundred fifty [men].

title: Exodus 38:27
text: And the sockets of the sanctuary were cast of the hundred talents of silver, and the sockets of the veil also, a hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

title: Exodus 38:28
text: And he made hooks for the pillars out of the seventeen hundred seventy-five shekels, and overlaid their capitals and joined them.

title: Exodus 38:29
text: And the bronze of the wave offering [was] seventy talents, and twenty-four hundred shekels,

title: Exodus 38:30
text: and with it he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the bronze altar, and the bronze grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

title: Exodus 38:31
text: and the sockets of the court all around, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court all around [bronze].

title: Exodus 39:1
text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. And they made the holy garments for Aaron, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:2
text: And he made the ephod [of] gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen].

title: Exodus 39:3
text: And they beat the gold into thin plates, and cut threads to work [it] into the blue, and into the purple, and into the scarlet, and into the bleached [linen], the work of an artisan.

title: Exodus 39:4
text: They made shoulder-pieces for it, to couple [it] together. It was coupled together by the two edges.

title: Exodus 39:5
text: And its fastening band which [was] on it, was of it, according to its work; gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen], even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:6
text: And they made stones of onyx set [in] plaited work of gold, engraved as signets are engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.

title: Exodus 39:7
text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, stones for a memorial to the sons of Israel, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:8
text: And he made the breast-pocket a work [of] an artisan, like the work of the ephod, of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen];

title: Exodus 39:9
text: it was square. They made the breast-pocket double. Its length [was] a span, and its breadth a span, doubled.

title: Exodus 39:10
text: And they set four rows of stones in it. One row was a ruby, a topaz, and a carbuncle, the first row.

title: Exodus 39:11
text: And the second row: an turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.

title: Exodus 39:12
text: And the third row: a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

title: Exodus 39:13
text: And the fourth row: a chrysolite, an agate, and a jasper; set in plaited work of gold in their settings.

title: Exodus 39:14
text: And the stones were according to the names of the sons of Israel, twelve, according to their names, [like] the engravings of a signet, every one with its name according to the twelve tribes.

title: Exodus 39:15
text: And they made cords of chains upon the breast-pocket, of woven work [of] pure gold.

title: Exodus 39:16
text: And they made two plaitings [of] gold and two gold rings. And they put the two rings on the two ends of the breast-pocket.

title: Exodus 39:17
text: And they put the two cords of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breast-pocket.

title: Exodus 39:18
text: And the two ends of the two cords were fastened in the two plaitings. And they put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, on its front.

title: Exodus 39:19
text: And they made two rings of gold. And they put [them] on the two ends of the breast-pocket, on its border, on the side of the ephod inward.

title: Exodus 39:20
text: And they made two golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the front of it, near the other coupling of it, above to the band of the ephod.

title: Exodus 39:21
text: And they bound the breast-pocket by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, so that it might be above the band of the ephod, and so that the breast-pocket might not be loosened from the ephod, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:22
text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

title: Exodus 39:23
text: And the opening in the middle of the robe [was] like the opening of a corselet, with a band around the opening, so that it might not tear.

title: Exodus 39:24
text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined bleached [linen].

title: Exodus 39:25
text: And they made bells [of] pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hems of the robe, all around, between the pomegranates:

title: Exodus 39:26
text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the hem of the robe to minister [in], even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:27
text: And they made the tunics [of] bleached [linen] [of] woven work for Aaron and for his sons.

title: Exodus 39:28
text: And [they made] a miter of bleached [linen], and the headdress of the caps [of] bleached [linen], and linen breeches [of] fine twined bleached [linen],

title: Exodus 39:29
text: and a girdle [of] fine twined bleached [linen], and blue, and purple, and scarlet, [of] needlework, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:30
text: And they made the plate of the holy crown [of] pure gold, and wrote upon it an inscription of the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

title: Exodus 39:31
text: And they tied a lace of blue to it, in order to fasten [it] on high upon the miter, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 39:32
text: And all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation was finished. And the sons of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses. So they did.

title: Exodus 39:33
text: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,

title: Exodus 39:34
text: and the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of dugong skins, and the veil of the covering,

title: Exodus 39:35
text: the ark of the testimony, and its staves, and the mercy-seat,

title: Exodus 39:36
text: the table, [and] all its vessels, and the showbread,

title: Exodus 39:37
text: the pure lampstand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels of it, and the oil for light,

title: Exodus 39:38
text: and the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the tabernacle door,

title: Exodus 39:39
text: the bronze altar, and its grate of bronze, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base,

title: Exodus 39:40
text: the curtains of the court, its pillars and its sockets, and the screen for the court gate, its cords, and its pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle for the tent of the congregation,

title: Exodus 39:41
text: the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 39:42
text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel made all the work.

title: Exodus 39:43
text: And Moses looked upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it. As the LORD commanded, even so they had done it. And Moses blessed them.

title: Exodus 40:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Exodus 40:2
text: You shall set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation on the first day of the first month.

title: Exodus 40:3
text: And you shall put the ark of the testimony in it, and you hall cover the ark with the veil.

title: Exodus 40:4
text: And you shall bring the table in, and set in order its arrangement. And you shall bring the lampstand in and light the lamps of it.

title: Exodus 40:5
text: And you shall set the altar of gold for the incense in front of the ark of the testimony, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:6
text: And you shall set the altar of the burnt offering in front of the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

title: Exodus 40:7
text: And you shall set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shall put water in it.

title: Exodus 40:8
text: And you shall set up the court all around, and place the screen at the court gate.

title: Exodus 40:9
text: And you shall take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle, and all in it, and shall sanctify it and all the vessels of it. And it shall be holy.

title: Exodus 40:10
text: And you shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar. And it shall be a most holy altar.

title: Exodus 40:11
text: And you shall anoint the laver and its base, and sanctify it.

title: Exodus 40:12
text: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

title: Exodus 40:13
text: And you shall put the holy garments on Aaron, and anoint him and sanctify him, so that he may minister to Me in the priest's office.

title: Exodus 40:14
text: And you shall bring his sons and clothe them [with] tunics.

title: Exodus 40:15
text: And you shall anoint them, even as you anointed their father, so that they may minister to Me in the priest's office. For their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood for their generations.

title: Exodus 40:16
text: And Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

title: Exodus 40:17
text: And it will be in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, the tabernacle was reared up.

title: Exodus 40:18
text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle and fastened its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and reared up its pillars.

title: Exodus 40:19
text: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering of the tent above upon it, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:20
text: And he took and placed the Testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy-seat on the ark from above.

title: Exodus 40:21
text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle and set up the veil of the covering, and covered the Ark of Testimony, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:22
text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil.

title: Exodus 40:23
text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD, even as the LORD had commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:24
text: And he put the lampstand in the tent of the congregation across from the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

title: Exodus 40:25
text: And he set up the lamps before the LORD, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:26
text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation in front of the veil.

title: Exodus 40:27
text: And he burned sweet incense on it, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:28
text: And he set up the screen [at] the door of the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:29
text: And he put the altar of burnt offering [by] the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered on it the burnt offering and the food offering, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:30
text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, for washing.

title: Exodus 40:31
text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

title: Exodus 40:32
text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near the altar, they washed, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Exodus 40:33
text: And he reared up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the court gate. And Moses finished the work.

title: Exodus 40:34
text: And the cloud covered the tabernacle of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:35
text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tabernacle of the congregation because the cloud stayed on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

title: Exodus 40:36
text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the sons of Israel journeyed on in all their journeys.

title: Exodus 40:37
text: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not journey until the day that it was taken up.

title: Exodus 40:38
text: For the cloud of the LORD [was] upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, in all their journeys.

title: Leviticus 1:1
text: And the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

title: Leviticus 1:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If any one of you brings an offering to the LORD, you shall bring your offering of the cattle, of the herd and of the flock.

title: Leviticus 1:3
text: If his offering [is] a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish. He shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 1:4
text: And he shall put his hand on the head of the burnt offering. And it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

title: Leviticus 1:5
text: And he shall kill the young bull before the LORD. And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood and sprinkle the blood all around on the altar that [is by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 1:6
text: And he shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into its pieces.

title: Leviticus 1:7
text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar and lay the wood in order on the fire.

title: Leviticus 1:8
text: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall arrange the parts with the head and the fat on the wood that [is] on the fire on the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:9
text: But its inward parts and its legs he shall wash in water. And the priest shall burn all on the altar, a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 1:10
text: And if his offering [is] of the flocks, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall bring a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 1:11
text: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD. And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:12
text: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. And the priest shall arrange on the wood that [is] on the fire, which [is] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:13
text: But he shall wash the inward parts and the legs in water; and the priest shall bring near all [of it] and burn it on the altar. It [is] a burnt sacrifice, a fire offering of a sweet fragrance to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 1:14
text: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD [is] out of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtle-doves or of young pigeons.

title: Leviticus 1:15
text: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head and burn [it] on the altar. And its blood shall be drained at the side of the altar.

title: Leviticus 1:16
text: And he shall pluck away its crop with its feathers, and throw it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes.

title: Leviticus 1:17
text: And he shall cut it in two with the wings of it, not dividing [it]. And the priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 2:1
text: And when anyone will offer a food offering to the LORD, his offering shall be [of] fine flour. And he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

title: Leviticus 2:2
text: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons, the priests. And he shall take out of it his handful of flour and its oil, with all its frankincense. And the priest shall burn the memorial of it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 2:3
text: And the rest of the food offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons', most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:4
text: And if you bring a sacrifice of a food offering baked in the oven, [it shall be] unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:5
text: And if your offering [is] a food offering on the griddle, your offering shall be of fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:6
text: You shall break it in pieces and pour oil on it. It [is] a food offering.

title: Leviticus 2:7
text: And if your offering [is] a food offering in the frying pan, it shall be made [of] fine flour with oil.

title: Leviticus 2:8
text: And you shall bring the food offering that is made of [these] things to the LORD. And when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.

title: Leviticus 2:9
text: And the priest shall take from the food offering a memorial of it, and shall burn [it] on the altar. It is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 2:10
text: And that which is left of the food offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons: [it is] most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:11
text: Any food offering which you shall bring to the LORD shall not be made with leaven. For you shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

title: Leviticus 2:12
text: As an offering of the firstfruits, you shall bring them to the LORD. But they shall not be burned on the altar for a sweet savor.

title: Leviticus 2:13
text: And every sacrifice of your food offering shall you season with salt. And you shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your food offering. You shall offer salt with all your offerings.

title: Leviticus 2:14
text: And if you bring a food offering of your firstfruits to the LORD, green ears roasted by fire, kernels of a garden, you shall bring near for a food offering your firstfruits,

title: Leviticus 2:15
text: And you shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It [is] a food offering.

title: Leviticus 2:16
text: And the priest shall burn it as incense with its memorial offering from its kernels and from its oil, besides all its frankincense, a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:1
text: And if his offering [is] a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offers from the herd, whether it is a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:2
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle the blood on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 3:3
text: And he shall bring near from the sacrifice the peace offering, a fire offering to the LORD. The fat that covers the inward parts, all the fat that [is] on the inward parts,

title: Leviticus 3:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat on them, on the loins, and the fold above the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove.

title: Leviticus 3:5
text: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar, on the burnt sacrifice on the wood, which is on the fire. [It is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:6
text: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering to the LORD [is] of the flocks, male or female, he shall bring it without blemish.

title: Leviticus 3:7
text: If he is bringing near a sheep for his offering, then he shall bring it near before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:8
text: And [he] shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation. And Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood all around on the altar.

title: Leviticus 3:9
text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering, a fire offering to the LORD. He shall take away its fat, all its fat next to the backbone, and all the fat that covers the inward parts, and all the fat that [is] on the inward parts,

title: Leviticus 3:10
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] on the loins, and the fold above the liver, beside the kidneys, he shall remove it.

title: Leviticus 3:11
text: And the priest shall burn it on the altar, bread of the fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:12
text: And if his offering [is] a goat, then he shall bring it near before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 3:13
text: And [he] shall lay his hand on its head and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation. And the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 3:14
text: And he shall offer his offering of it, a fire offering to the LORD, the fat that covers the inward parts, and all the fat on the inward parts,

title: Leviticus 3:15
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which [is] on the loins, and the fold above the liver, beside the kidneys, he shall remove.

title: Leviticus 3:16
text: And the priest shall burn them on the altar, bread of the fire offering for a sweet savor. All the fat [is] the LORD's.

title: Leviticus 3:17
text: [It shall be] a statute forever for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that you eat neither fat nor blood.

title: Leviticus 4:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 4:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which ought not to be done, and shall do any one of them,

title: Leviticus 4:3
text: if the priest who is anointed sins, resulting in guilt to the people, then he shall bring for his sin, which he has sinned, a young bull, a son of the herd, a perfect one, to the LORD for a sin offering.

title: Leviticus 4:4
text: And he shall bring the young bull to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD, and [he] shall lay his hand on the young bull's head, and kill the young bull before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 4:5
text: And the priest who is anointed shall take of the young bull's blood, and shall bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:6
text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, at the front of the veil of the holy place.

title: Leviticus 4:7
text: And the priest shall put [some] of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which [is] in the tabernacle of the congregation. And he shall pour all the blood of the young bull at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:8
text: And he shall lift up from it all the fat of the young bull for the sin offering; the fat that covers the inward parts, and all the fat on the inward parts,

title: Leviticus 4:9
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat on them, beside the loins, and he shall remove the fold above the liver, with the kidneys.

title: Leviticus 4:10
text: Even as it was lifted from the young bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings, the priest shall burn them on the altar of the burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 4:11
text: And the skin of the young bull, and all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, and its inward parts, and its dung,

title: Leviticus 4:12
text: even the whole bull shall he carry forth outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on the wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

title: Leviticus 4:13
text: And if the whole company of Israel sins through ignorance, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and if they do that which ought not to be done to any of all the commands of the LORD, and are guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:14
text: when the sin is known which they have sinned against it, then the congregation shall bring near a young bull for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:15
text: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the young bull before the LORD, and the young bull shall be killed before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 4:16
text: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the young bull's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:17
text: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle seven times before the LORD, before the veil.

title: Leviticus 4:18
text: And he shall put [some] of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation. And he shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:19
text: And he shall take all its fat from it and burn [it] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:20
text: And he shall do with the young bull as he did with the young bull for a sin offering; so shall he do to it. And the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

title: Leviticus 4:21
text: And he shall carry forth the young bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It [is] a sin offering for the congregation.

title: Leviticus 4:22
text: When a ruler has sinned and through ignorance has acted against one of the commands of the LORD his God, which [is] not to be done, and is guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:23
text: or if his sin which he has sinned shall be made known to him, he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.

title: Leviticus 4:24
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the goat and kill it in the place where he kills the burnt offering before the LORD. It [is] a sin offering.

title: Leviticus 4:25
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put [it] on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out its blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 4:26
text: And he shall burn all its fat on the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings. And the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 4:27
text: And if any one of the people of the land sins through ignorance, by doing that which is not to be done against one of the commands of the LORD, and is guilty;

title: Leviticus 4:28
text: or if his sin which he has sinned shall be made known to him, then he shall bring his offering, a ewe of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has sinned.

title: Leviticus 4:29
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 4:30
text: And the priest shall take of its blood with his finger and put [it] on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood of it at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:31
text: And he shall take away all its fat, as the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings. And the priest shall burn [it] on the altar for a sweet savor to the LORD. And the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 4:32
text: And if he brings a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.

title: Leviticus 4:33
text: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where he kills the burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 4:34
text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put [it] on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all its blood at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 4:35
text: And he shall take away all the fat of it, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings. And the priest shall burn them on the altar, on the fire offerings to the LORD. And the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:1
text: And if a soul sins and hears the voice of swearing, and [is] a witness, and he has seen or known, if he does not tell it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 5:2
text: Or if a soul touches any unclean thing, whether a dead body of an unclean beast, or a dead body of unclean cattle, or the dead body of unclean swarming things, and [if] it is hidden from him that he is unclean and guilty--

title: Leviticus 5:3
text: or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever uncleanness by which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him, and he knows, then he shall be guilty.

title: Leviticus 5:4
text: Or if a soul swears, pronouncing with [his] lips to do evil or to do good, whatever it is that a man speaks rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him, and he knows, then he shall be guilty of one of these.

title: Leviticus 5:5
text: And it shall be when he is guilty in one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned.

title: Leviticus 5:6
text: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a doe of the goats, for a sin offering. And the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin.

title: Leviticus 5:7
text: And if his hand cannot reach to a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass which he has committed, two turtle-doves or two young pigeons to the LORD-- one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 5:8
text: And he shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer for the sin offering first, and shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not divide [it].

title: Leviticus 5:9
text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood shall be drained at the bottom of the altar. It [is] a sin offering.

title: Leviticus 5:10
text: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance. And the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:11
text: But if he is not able to bring two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, neither shall he put frankincense on it. For it [is] a sin offering.

title: Leviticus 5:12
text: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his full handful of it, a memorial of it, and burn [it] on the altar, on the fire offering to the LORD. It is a sin offering.

title: Leviticus 5:13
text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin that he has sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him. And [the rest] shall be the priest's, as a food offering.

title: Leviticus 5:14
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 5:15
text: If a soul commits a trespass and sins through ignorance in the holy things of the LORD, then he shall bring for his trespass to the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flock, together with an amount set by you, by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

title: Leviticus 5:16
text: And he shall make it good [in] which he has sinned, in the holy thing, and he shall add the fifth part of it, and give it to the priest. And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:17
text: And if a soul sins, and he has done that which ought not to be done, any one from all the commands of the LORD, and does not know, and he is guilty and bears his iniquity;

title: Leviticus 5:18
text: then he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, at your evaluation, for a trespass offering, to the priest. And the priest shall make an atonement for him for his ignorance in which he erred without knowing it, and it shall be forgiven him.

title: Leviticus 5:19
text: It [is] a trespass offering. He has certainly trespassed against the LORD.

title: Leviticus 6:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:2
text: If a soul sins, and acts unfaithfully against the LORD, and lies to his neighbor as to a deposit-- or as to security, or by robbery, or has extorted his neighbor,

title: Leviticus 6:3
text: or has found that which was lost and lies concerning it and swears falsely-- in any of all [these] that a man does, sinning in it,

title: Leviticus 6:4
text: then, it shall be, because he sinned and is guilty, he shall pay back that which he got by robbery; or if he robbed the thing extorted; or the deposit which had been deposited with him; or the lost thing which he had found;

title: Leviticus 6:5
text: or all that which he swore about falsely, --he shall even repay it in its principal, and the fifth part he shall add to it, to whomever it belongs. He shall give it on the day of his guilt offering.

title: Leviticus 6:6
text: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, together with an amount set by you, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

title: Leviticus 6:7
text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD, and it shall be forgiven him for anything of all that he has done by being guilty in it.

title: Leviticus 6:8
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 6:9
text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the burnt offering. It is the burnt offering for burning on the altar all night to the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

title: Leviticus 6:10
text: And the priest shall put on his linen garment. And he shall put his linen breeches on his flesh and take up the ashes which the fire has consumed with the burnt offering on the altar. And he shall put them beside the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:11
text: And he shall strip off his garments and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

title: Leviticus 6:12
text: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it. It shall not be put out. And the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order on it. And he shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 6:13
text: The fire shall always be burning on the altar. It shall never go out.

title: Leviticus 6:14
text: And this [is] the law of the food offering. The sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD before the altar.

title: Leviticus 6:15
text: And he shall take from it his handful of the flour of the food offering, and of the oil of it, and all the frankincense which is on the food offering, and shall burn [it] on the altar for a sweet savor, the memorial of it, to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 6:16
text: And the rest of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten [with] unleavened bread in the holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 6:17
text: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it [as] their portion of My offerings made by fire. It [is] most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering is.

title: Leviticus 6:18
text: All the males among the sons of Aaron shall eat of it. [It shall be] a statute forever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Everyone that touches them shall be holy.

title: Leviticus 6:19
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 6:20
text: This [is] the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day [he is] anointed, the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a continual food offering, half of it in the morning and half of it at night.

title: Leviticus 6:21
text: It shall be made in a pan with oil; you shall bring it in. And you shall offer the baked pieces of the food offering, a sweet savor to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 6:22
text: And the priest of his sons, who is anointed in his stead, shall offer it. [It is] a statute forever to the LORD. It shall be wholly burnt.

title: Leviticus 6:23
text: For every food offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt. It shall not be eaten.

title: Leviticus 6:24
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 6:25
text: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the sin offering. In the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD. It [is] most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:26
text: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in the holy place, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 6:27
text: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. And when any of its blood is sprinkled on any garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in the holy place.

title: Leviticus 6:28
text: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken. And if it is boiled in a bronze pot, it shall be both scoured and rinsed in water.

title: Leviticus 6:29
text: All the males among the priests shall eat of it. It [is] most holy.

title: Leviticus 6:30
text: And no sin offering, of which [any] of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation for atonement in the sanctuary, shall be eaten. It shall be burned up in the fire.

title: Leviticus 7:1
text: And this [is] the law of the trespass offering. It is most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:2
text: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, they shall kill the trespass offering. And he shall sprinkle its blood on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 7:3
text: And he shall offer all its fat; he shall offer the fat tail of it, and the fat that covers the inward parts,

title: Leviticus 7:4
text: and the two kidneys, and the fat on them, on the loins, and the fold above the liver, beside the kidneys, he shall take away.

title: Leviticus 7:5
text: And the priest shall burn them on the altar for a fire offering to the LORD. It is a trespass offering.

title: Leviticus 7:6
text: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It shall be eaten in the holy place. It [is] most holy.

title: Leviticus 7:7
text: As the sin offering, so [is] the trespass offering. There is one law for them. The priest that makes atonement with it, it is his.

title: Leviticus 7:8
text: And the priest that offers any man's burnt offering, that priest shall have the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered; it is his.

title: Leviticus 7:9
text: And all the food offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the frying-pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest's that offers it; it is his.

title: Leviticus 7:10
text: And every food offering mixed with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one like another.

title: Leviticus 7:11
text: And this [is] the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which he shall offer to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 7:12
text: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil, of fine flour, fried.

title: Leviticus 7:13
text: Besides the cakes, he shall offer [for] his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:14
text: And from it he shall offer one cake out of the whole sacrifice for a heave offering to the LORD, to the priest that sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings; it is his.

title: Leviticus 7:15
text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

title: Leviticus 7:16
text: But if the sacrifice of his offering [is] a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offers his sacrifice. And on the next day also the rest of it shall be eaten.

title: Leviticus 7:17
text: But the rest of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

title: Leviticus 7:18
text: And if [any] of the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offerings is eaten at all the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed to him who offers it. It shall be an abomination, and the soul that eats of it shall bear his iniquity.

title: Leviticus 7:19
text: And the flesh that touches any unclean [thing] shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. And as for the flesh, all who are clean shall eat of it.

title: Leviticus 7:20
text: But the soul that eats [of] the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings that pertain to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:21
text: And the soul that shall touch any unclean [thing], of the uncleanness of man, or any unclean animal, or an unclean abominable thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings which pertain to the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:22
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 7:23
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, You shall not eat any fat of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

title: Leviticus 7:24
text: And the fat of a dead body, and the fat of a thing torn, may be used in any other use. But you shall in no way eat it.

title: Leviticus 7:25
text: For whoever eats the fat of the beast of which men offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul that eats [it] shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:26
text: And you shall not eat any blood, of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

title: Leviticus 7:27
text: Any soul who eats any blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

title: Leviticus 7:28
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

title: Leviticus 7:29
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD, shall bring his sacrifice to the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:30
text: His own hands shall bring in the fire offerings of the LORD. He shall bring the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be waved [for] a wave-offering before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 7:31
text: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar. But the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

title: Leviticus 7:32
text: And you shall give the right shoulder to the priest [for] a heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 7:33
text: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for [his] part.

title: Leviticus 7:34
text: For I have taken the wave breast and the heave shoulder from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons by a statute forever from among the sons of Israel.

title: Leviticus 7:35
text: This is the [portion] of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest's office,

title: Leviticus 7:36
text: which the LORD commanded to be given to them of the sons of Israel, in the day that He anointed them as a statute forever throughout their generations.

title: Leviticus 7:37
text: This [is] the law of the burnt offering, of the food offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifices of the peace offerings,

title: Leviticus 7:38
text: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai, in the day that He commanded the sons of Israel to offer their sacrifices to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

title: Leviticus 8:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

title: Leviticus 8:2
text: Take Aaron, and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a young bull for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread.

title: Leviticus 8:3
text: And gather all the congregation together to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 8:4
text: And Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. And the assembly was gathered together to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

title: Leviticus 8:5
text: And Moses said to the assembly, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

title: Leviticus 8:6
text: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

title: Leviticus 8:7
text: And he put on him the tunic, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him, and girded him with the embroidered girdle of the ephod, and bound [it] to him with it.

title: Leviticus 8:8
text: And he put the breast-pocket on him. Also he put in the breast-pocket the Urim and the Thummim.

title: Leviticus 8:9
text: And he put the miter on his head. Also he put the golden plate, the holy crown, on the miter, on his forehead, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:10
text: And Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] in it, and sanctified them.

title: Leviticus 8:11
text: And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, both the laver and its base, to sanctify them.

title: Leviticus 8:12
text: And he poured of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to sanctify him.

title: Leviticus 8:13
text: And Moses brought Aaron's sons and put tunics on them, and girded them with girdles, and bound turbans on them, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:14
text: And he brought the young bull for the sin offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the young bull for the sin offering.

title: Leviticus 8:15
text: And he killed [it]. And Moses took the blood and put it on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation on it.

title: Leviticus 8:16
text: And he took all the fat on the inward parts, and the fold above the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses burned [it] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 8:17
text: But the young bull and its hide, its flesh and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:18
text: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

title: Leviticus 8:19
text: And he killed [it]. And Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 8:20
text: And he cut the ram into pieces. And Moses burned the head and the pieces and the fat.

title: Leviticus 8:21
text: And he washed the inward parts and the legs in water. And Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It [was] a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:22
text: And he brought the second ram, the ram of consecration. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

title: Leviticus 8:23
text: And he killed [it]. And Moses took of the blood of it, and put [it] on the tip of Aaron's right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

title: Leviticus 8:24
text: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the great toes of their right feet. And Moses sprinkled the blood on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 8:25
text: And he took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat on the inward parts, and the fold [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder.

title: Leviticus 8:26
text: And he took one unleavened cake out of the basket of unleavened bread that [was] before the LORD, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put [them] on the fat, and on the right shoulder.

title: Leviticus 8:27
text: And he put all on Aaron's hands, and on his sons' hands, and waved them [for] a wave offering before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 8:28
text: And Moses took them off their hands and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They [were] consecrations for a sweet savor. It [is] a fire offering to the LORD.

title: Leviticus 8:29
text: And Moses took the breast and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses' part of the ram of consecration, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 8:30
text: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which [was] on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, [and] on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons' garments with him. And he sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

title: Leviticus 8:31
text: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. And eat it there with the bread in the basket of consecrations, as I have commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

title: Leviticus 8:32
text: And that which remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

title: Leviticus 8:33
text: You shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation seven days, until the days of your consecration are at an end. For He shall consecrate you seven days.

title: Leviticus 8:34
text: As He has done this day, the LORD has commanded you to do, to make an atonement for you.

title: Leviticus 8:35
text: And you shall remain [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, so that you do not die. For so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 8:36
text: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:1
text: And it happened on the eighth day. Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel.

title: Leviticus 9:2
text: And he said to Aaron, Take a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram without blemish for a burnt offering, and offer before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 9:3
text: And speak to the sons of Israel, saying, Take a kid of the goats for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb of the first year, all without blemish, for a burnt offering.

title: Leviticus 9:4
text: Also take a young bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD, and a food offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.

title: Leviticus 9:5
text: And they brought [that] which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation. And all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 9:6
text: And Moses said, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do. And the glory of the LORD shall appear to you.

title: Leviticus 9:7
text: And Moses said to Aaron, Go to the altar, and offer your sin offering and your burnt offerings, and make an atonement for yourself and for the people. And offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them, even as the LORD commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:8
text: Aaron then went to the altar and killed the calf of the sin offering, which [was] for himself.

title: Leviticus 9:9
text: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him. And he dipped his finger in the blood and put [it] on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:10
text: But he burned the fat and the kidneys and the fold above the liver of the sin offering on the altar, even as the LORD commanded Moses.

title: Leviticus 9:11
text: And he burned the flesh and the hide with fire outside the camp.

title: Leviticus 9:12
text: And he killed the burnt offering. And Aaron's sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled all around on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:13
text: And they presented the burnt offering to him, with the pieces of it, and the head. And he burned [them] on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:14
text: And he washed the inward parts and the legs, and burned [them] on the burnt offering on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:15
text: And he brought the people's offering. And he took the goat, the sin offering for the people, and killed it and offered it for sin as the first.

title: Leviticus 9:16
text: And he brought the burnt offering and offered it according to the ordinance.

title: Leviticus 9:17
text: And he brought the food offering and took a handful of it, and burned [it] on the altar besides the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

title: Leviticus 9:18
text: He also killed the young bull and the ram [for] a sacrifice of peace offerings for the people. And Aaron's sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled on the altar all around.

title: Leviticus 9:19
text: And they brought the fat of the young bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the inward parts, and the kidneys, and the fold [above] the liver.

title: Leviticus 9:20
text: And they put the fat on the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

title: Leviticus 9:21
text: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved [for] a wave offering before the Lord, as Moses commanded.

title: Leviticus 9:22
text: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering the sin offering and the burnt offering and peace offerings.

title: Leviticus 9:23
text: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out and blessed the people. And the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

title: Leviticus 9:24
text: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and burned up the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. And all the people saw and shouted and fell on their faces.

title: Leviticus 10:1
text: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer and put fire in it, and put incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which He had not commanded them not to do.

title: Leviticus 10:2
text: And there went out fire from the LORD and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

title: Leviticus 10:3
text: Then Moses said to Aaron, It [is] that which the LORD spoke, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

title: Leviticus 10:4
text: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, Come near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

title: Leviticus 10:5
text: And they came near and carried them in their coats out of the camp, as Moses had said.

title: Leviticus 10:6
text: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar his sons, Do not uncover your heads nor tear your clothes, lest you die, and lest He be angry on all the people. But let your brothers, the whole of Israel, mourn the burning which the LORD has kindled.

title: Leviticus 10:7
text: And you shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die. For the anointing oil of the LORD [is] on you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:8
text: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:9
text: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, neither you nor your sons with you, when you go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die, a statute forever throughout your generations.

title: Leviticus 10:10
text: Even for a distinction between the holy and unholy, and between the unclean and clean

title: Leviticus 10:11
text: and so that you may teach the sons of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by the hand of Moses.

title: Leviticus 10:12
text: And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the food offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar. For it [is] most holy.

title: Leviticus 10:13
text: And you shall eat in the holy place, because it [is] your due, and your sons' due, of the fire offerings of the LORD made by fire. For so I am commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:14
text: And the wave breast and heave shoulder you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons and your daughters with you. For [they have been] given for your portion and the portion of your sons out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the sons of Israel.

title: Leviticus 10:15
text: The heave shoulder and the wave breast they shall bring with the fire offerings of the fat, to wave [for] a wave offering before the LORD. And it shall be yours, and your sons' with you, by a statute forever, even as the LORD has commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:16
text: And Moses carefully looked for the goat of the sin offering. And behold, it was burned! And he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron left alive, saying,

title: Leviticus 10:17
text: Why have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, since it [is] most holy, and He has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

title: Leviticus 10:18
text: Behold! The blood of it was not brought within the holy place! You should indeed have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.

title: Leviticus 10:19
text: And Aaron said to Moses, Behold, this day they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD. And such things have happened to me. And [if] I had eaten the sin offering today, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

title: Leviticus 10:20
text: And Moses heard, and it was good in his eyes.

title: Leviticus 11:1
text: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

title: Leviticus 11:2
text: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, These [are] the animals which you shall eat among all the animals that are in the earth.

title: Leviticus 11:3
